preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: A weathered ship slides out of the fog. Barnacle-crusted hull, patched sails, and cannons aimed at your ship already.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: So another pup thinks they can take old Barnie. Many have tried... none've sailed home.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I've been raiding these waters longer than you've been alive. Don't matter. You'll be back where you started before long.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Don't let Pete scare you. He's all bark... or whatever sound it is that he makes.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: He's cocky only because he's never had a real challenge before.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: What're ya waiting for, lil pup? Got cold fins now that you've seen me in the flesh?

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: You love hearing yourself talk don't ya, Pete. Let's take him down cap'n. Can't stand to hear him talk anymore.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Ready your guns. This is where your story ends.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: So you're the little hook that's been snagging my freight. Wondered why my couriers've been late.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Captain Krusty was it? I see why you got that name.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Don't you dare disrespect me. I own these straits. You lot are meddling in business where you don't belong.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: You may run these straits, but I run these streets.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: That didn't come out as hard as you'd think, Mako.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Regrets.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: Krust looks annoyed. But you weren't trying to be friends anyway.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You've cost me enough time. It's time to pay up.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Someone above you. There is always someone above. This whole sea is just fish too frightened to look up, captain. Let us give this one a reason to.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Strike your colors or strike your guns. Either way this consignment sails on without you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The fog thickens until sea and sky blur into dull gray. Out of it, a slow-built ship glides up. Decks stacked with rolled charts and brass-bound sextants.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I heard a young captain was reading my routes.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: It's him. The Finndicate's chartmaker.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I prefer to be called The Cartographer. Has a nicer ring to it. You cut off my supply line from Krust. It's unfortunate, he was easy to work with. If a bit naive.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: No matter. The charts are nearly complete. I won't have time to entertain you any longer.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Entertain us? We were just about to show YOU a good time.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Me? You won't even be able to reach me. That's us chartmakers... always playing the background.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Why are you working for the Finndicate at all?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Mm... we've got bigger goals than the tiny brains of yours can even comprehend. Now if you'll excuse me.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: We're not letting him get away. Let's show him that pen and paper can't do what a cannon can.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: You sailed into the Gullet and brought down ranks of low barracuda hulls to arrive at the Tollmaster himself.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You've come a long way down my channel, captain. I see that you've become a bit too familiar with the finances of the Finndicate. That's my sea to sail. Not yours.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Tollmaster Spet... I presume. Why do all the operations go through you? What's the purpose of the Gullet?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: I handle the Finndicate's accounting. Sounds boring, but it gives me a ton of power. And control. You've messed with our bottom line by sinking some of our best. And that's not something that we just write off.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: The Finndicate doesn't just do normal business anymore, it seems. What are you guys really up to?

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: You've got captains feeding you stolen resources. A cartographer supplying you charts to... who knows where. None of this makes sense... at least in any good way.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Who determines what's good? I just make sure everything balances out.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then surely you know that there's some illegal activity going on within the Finndicate!

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: No one audits me. I say what's illegal or not. And the only thing I know that is illegal is your trespassing into my territory.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: I've never met an accountant that could fight.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You're a fool then. Our battles are done with numbers.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Let's show Spet who's putting up the real numbers.

phase2.dialogueLine: Enough games. Run out the real guns.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: Past the harbor wall the Coffers open up. A large galleon is already coming about to meet you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Far enough, captain. Nobody sails into the Coffers uninvited and lives to tell the tale.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Ruse...

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Admiral Ruse, to you. You lot have seemed to cause quite the stir. Mighty bold of you to show up to the Finndicate's coffers all on your own.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Mighty bold of you to steal from the weak. Does the Finndicate not have enough at their disposal?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: The Finndicate's mission goes far beyond your own.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: And what would that be?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: That's way above your pay grade.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Well then it's time to claim our paycheck here, Ruse.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: That's Admiral Ruse, to you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Sorry, that title's above your pay grade.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Brace yourself!

phases.dialogueLine: You cracked the ledger. You have not cleared the debt.

check.name: The Big Gun
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster hauls the reserve cannon onto the rail and swings the muzzle toward you.
check.hint: A shot this heavy has to be met with a crew ability. A defensive one that gets something between you and the muzzle before it fires. Your own brace/dodge won’t turn it aside.
check.counteredLine: The big shot slams into your cover and glances wide.
check.failLine: The reserve cannon speaks, and nothing turned it aside.

phases.dialogueLine: You think the shelves are bare? I keep a reserve deck for captains like you.

check.name: Cooking the Books
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster ducks low behind the counter and starts working the ledger, fast.
check.hint: Don't let him finish the tally. Fire a crew ability to break it. Something disrupting to foul his concentration, or a heavy-hitting one to overpower him before the count closes, or he balances the ledger in his favor.
check.counteredLine: You break his tally before it can close.
check.failLine: The ledger balances in his favor.

phases.dialogueLine: Nothing left to sell. Then I sink you and take the lot back myself.

check.name: Fire Sale
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster touches a torch to the stock and the whole Cache goes up in flame.
check.hint: The whole stock goes up at once and sets your hull ablaze. Fire a crew ability before it catches, a recovery one or a defensive one, and if it does catch, only a crew heal puts the fire out.
check.counteredLine: You smother the blaze before it can spread.
check.failLine: The fire sale catches, and your hull goes up in flame.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The Cache's shutters roll up into a gun-deck, and the keeper stands behind a counter of run-out cannon, smiling like he's already counted your coin.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Every captain who ever beat me bought the means to do it off my own shelf. *You included.*

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then I will beat you with the one thing I never bought off your shelf, keeper. My teeth.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then we'll sink you with your own goods. Hold still.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Your goods? Everything you carry was a loan, captain. *And I am calling one back.*

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Let's see how bold you sail once I reach across the counter and take back the piece you leaned on most.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Take your trinkets back, keeper. The one thing you never sold this captain is the crew standing on her deck. Good luck reaching across the counter for us.

phases.dialogueLine: Sink me? Lad, I have been at the bottom for years. Try taking something off me instead.

check.name: The Salvage
check.telegraph: He swings a crane over the rail and hauls up the reinforced plating you never came back for. He means to wear it.
check.hint: Disrupt him. He cannot bolt it on if he cannot work.
check.counteredLine: The crane fouls and the plating goes back over the side. He does not take that well.
check.failLine: He bolts your plating over his own ribs and the holes close up.

phases.dialogueLine: You left the fire-shot on my counter. I have had a long time to think about where to put it.

check.name: The Long Burn
check.telegraph: He packs the incendiary you passed over and stands there holding a lit match, in no hurry at all.
check.hint: Survive it. Get a barrier up, or be ready to put the fire out.
check.counteredLine: The shot bursts against the barrier and burns itself out on open water.
check.failLine: Your own fire-shot goes through the deck and the ship starts to cook.

phases.dialogueLine: Every captain I ever armed, I watched sink. I always did keep the good glass back.

check.name: The Called Shot
check.telegraph: He raises your Gunner's Sight to a dead eye, takes the bearing off your own compass, and holds it. He does not need to hurry.
check.hint: Defend. Put something between you and a shot that is already aimed.
check.counteredLine: The shot lands where your hull was and finds a braced wall instead. He mutters something about waste.
check.failLine: He fires down your own sights. The shot goes exactly where he meant it to.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The gun-deck is exactly as you left it, down to the lantern oil. The counter is still stocked. The keeper is still behind it, and you can see the shutters through him.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Dead men keep better books than living ones. Everything you left on my counter, everything you melted down since. I have it all, and I have *all the time there is*.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then you'll not mind us taking it back off you. Twice, if it comes to that.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: *They always come back.* That is the one thing I could ever count on.

special.name: Dig In
special.line: The Bank drops his weight into the silt and settles, and the shot just thumps into mud.

special.name: Deadwood
special.line: Root and deadwood come up under the hull and wrap the rudder, and the wheel goes dead in your hands.

special.name: Chain-Shot
special.line: Chain-shot screams through your powder line and your guns cough where they roared.

special.name: Hull-Cracker
special.line: A cracker round splits your seams wide open, and every blow after it will find the gap.

special.name: Old Wounds
special.line: Old Scar takes the hit the way he has taken every other one, and the hole closes while you watch.

special.name: Gag Order
special.line: The gag order comes down, and your crew go quiet mid-shout.

special.name: Still Water
special.line: Sal stops moving. The chop goes flat around him, and every gun on the line goes quiet.

phases.dialogueLine: The don said bring him your colors. He never said in one piece.

check.name: The Death Roll
check.telegraph: Sal takes your hull in his teeth, sets his feet against the swell, and starts to turn.
check.hint: He is going to roll, and he will not let go. Only a crew ability gets something between your hull and that grip. Your own brace or dodge does nothing here.
check.counteredLine: He rolls against braced timber, tears off a mouthful of nothing, and lets go spitting splinters.
check.failLine: He rolls, and he keeps rolling, and your hull comes apart along the grain.

phases.dialogueLine: You want the don? Then come through my back. Nothing you carry goes through my back. Not one shot of it.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The blockade line rides the swell ahead: the don's own escort armada, lanterns doused, gunports open. At the center of it, something long and low sits *so still in the water you take it for a spar*.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Far enough, captain. The don's water starts where your charts stop.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then we're exactly where we mean to be. Move your line.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Move it, or be moved with it. I have shifted reefs that argued less than you, enforcer.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: The Quartermaster talked too much and kept too little. I do not talk, and *I do not let go*. Ask anyone who ever got this far.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You will not see me move. *You will only notice I have you.*

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: I noticed you an hour ago, love. A thing that lies that still is a thing afraid to move first. Let us find out what it is afraid of.

ultimate.name: Broadside Royale
ultimate.line: Every gun on the deck speaks at once, in the don’s name.

special.name: False Court
special.line: Lantern-rigs bloom down his rail, a court of false colors with only one throne among them.

special.name: Iron Etiquette
special.line: Iron shutters slam over every line you’d take. Nobody reaches the don in one knock.

special.name: Kingmaker’s Gale
special.line: He whistles a wind out of dead water, and your gun-deck pitches with it.

special.name: Omertà
special.line: The left hand draws a line across his throat, and your crew’s shouts die in the wind.

ultimate.name: The Quiet Word
ultimate.line: What the don whispers, the guns repeat.

special.name: Marked for the Don
special.line: He reads your name off a short list, and every gun in the court knows where to aim.

ultimate.name: Final Counsel
ultimate.line: His advice, delivered all at once.

phase2.dialogueLine: You do not close an account by sinking it once, captain. Let me show you the interest.

special.name: Court of Crowns
special.line: The court closes around the throne. A dozen crowns, and only one that bleeds.

ultimate.name: The Deep Verdict
ultimate.line: The don passes sentence, and the water carries it out.

openingCheck.name: The Don’s Court
openingCheck.telegraph: The whole drowned court trains its guns on your hull at once, waiting on the don’s nod.
openingCheck.hint: You cannot out-gun a whole court. Weather the opening volley. A brace, a shield, or a big heal will all ride it out.
openingCheck.counteredLine: Your crew answers first, and the court’s opening volley scatters wide.
openingCheck.failLine: Nobody stands with you, and the whole court fires as one.

phases.dialogueLine: You came for a don. The deep sent you something older. Look at the WIDTH of what you’ve been bargaining with.

check.name: The Maw
check.telegraph: The don’s hull ROLLS, and keeps rolling, a jaw the size of your broadside opening under the waterline.
check.hint: A bite that wide can’t be weaved. Harden the hull with a brace, or blast the jaw apart with a big shot before it shuts.
check.counteredLine: Your crew throws the maw off its line and it grinds iron instead of deck.
check.failLine: The maw closes on your hull and something structural gives. Every blow after this one finds the gap.

phases.dialogueLine: There it is. The blood. Now the whole ocean knows where you are.

check.name: Blood in the Water
check.telegraph: He rakes a long gash down your hull and circles wide, the sea reddening with every pass at the smell of it.
check.hint: The wound is what keeps drawing him. Close it with a heal, or snare him off the blood-trail before he circles back in.
check.counteredLine: Your crew answers the wound and the blood-trail goes cold; he loses the scent.
check.failLine: He follows the blood straight in, tears the gash wider, and the wound feeds him.

phases.dialogueLine: Enough court. Enough colors. The Finndicate was never the family, captain. It was the FEEDING.

check.name: The Sounding
check.telegraph: The megalodon SOUNDS. The whole sea dips as he goes deep, gathering water for a breach that will land on your deck.
check.hint: You can’t block a falling mountain. You have to break the dive itself. Snare him out of it, or blast him up early with a big shot.
check.counteredLine: The dive breaks. He breaches early, wide, and the wave takes the blow for you.
check.failLine: The sea goes still. Then it goes UP, and the breach leaves your ship reeling and slow to answer.

phases.dialogueLine: Down here, captain, EVERYTHING feeds the family. Even you.

check.name: The Undertow
check.telegraph: He circles fast and low and the whole drowned court fires down the whirlpool at once, a wall of iron closing on your hull.
check.hint: No brace holds against a wall this wide. Raise a shield to break it, or out-heal what gets through.
check.counteredLine: The barrage breaks on your crew’s answer in a wall of spray.
check.failLine: The undertow drags your broadside off true, and the court’s iron rakes you while your guns swing wild.

phases.dialogueLine: You crossed the WHOLE family to get here. Let me show you what the family is FOR.

check.name: The Last Bite
check.telegraph: The megalodon rears his whole bulk from the water for one final lunge. And for one breath his throat hangs open above your deck.
check.hint: The throat hangs open for one breath. Fire everything down it with a big shot, or throw up a brace or shield and ride out the lunge.
check.counteredLine: Your crew fires straight down his throat and the last bite dies in the water.
check.failLine: The last bite comes down, and the deep finally closes over you.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: Past the thrown gates the water goes still and black, and the don’s flagship sits at anchor in the middle of it. Lit like a feast, silent like a courtroom.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Sit down, captain. You’ve crossed my whole family to reach this table. The least I can do is hear your last request.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: We read your books, Finleone. Every coin accounted for. Almost every coin.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: ...So. *You found the margin.*

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: We found it, don. The account your whole empire was really paying into. You were never the top of this, and you know it. Does that frighten you as much as it frightens your books?

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Then you know why *nobody* leaves this water. Guns out, captain. The court is in session.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Look at him, captain. The biggest name in the whole sea, and he is afraid of a single letter. That is the only thing in this room worth knowing.

lines: Heh.
All that patience. And it was you at the end of the line.
The dark goes out of the water. The morning comes back the way it left, from him outward.

ultimate.name: The Long Line
ultimate.line: All that patience, paid out at once.

phases.dialogueLine: Plate that outlived its own bones. Do you know how long I waited to wear this?
You have never once been fast enough. Let me show you what fast is.
You have put more iron through me than most captains see in a lifetime. Look at me.
I have been reading you since your first cast. There is nothing left of you I have not written down.
One last ride, captain. You landed this one yourself. Let us see you do it twice.

preFightDialogue.speaker: narrator
preFightDialogue.text: The water ahead is flat and wrong, and the ship sitting on it is flying his colors.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: You came. *Of course* you came.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Six of them in your hold and you still brought the ship. That is the thing about you, captain. You have never once done the sensible thing.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: He has every one of them in him now. Whatever he throws at us, captain, we taught it to him.

preFightDialogue.speaker: crew
preFightDialogue.text: Then we know exactly what is coming.

preFightDialogue.speaker: boss
preFightDialogue.text: Let us find out what all that practice was for.

phase2.dialogueLine: On your feet, old captain. We're not done yet.
Down? Plate's still warm. Try again.
You sketched one chart of me. There's always a deeper sounding.
You think the bill's settled? I always collect twice.
Enough games. Run out the real guns.

phases.dialogueLine: You cracked the ledger. You have not cleared the debt.

check.name: The Big Gun
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster hauls the reserve cannon onto the rail and swings the muzzle toward you.
check.hint: A shot this heavy has to be met with a crew ability. A defensive one that gets something between you and the muzzle before it fires. Your own brace/dodge won’t turn it aside.
check.counteredLine: The big shot slams into your cover and glances wide.
check.failLine: The reserve cannon speaks, and nothing turned it aside.

phases.dialogueLine: You think the shelves are bare? I keep a reserve deck for captains like you.

check.name: Cooking the Books
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster ducks low behind the counter and starts working the ledger, fast.
check.hint: Don't let him finish the tally. Fire a crew ability to break it. Something disrupting to foul his concentration, or a heavy-hitting one to overpower him before the count closes, or he balances the ledger in his favor.
check.counteredLine: You break his tally before it can close.
check.failLine: The ledger balances in his favor.

phases.dialogueLine: Nothing left to sell. Then I sink you and take the lot back myself.

check.name: Fire Sale
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster touches a torch to the stock and the whole Cache goes up in flame.
check.hint: The whole stock goes up at once and sets your hull ablaze. Fire a crew ability before it catches, a recovery one or a defensive one, and if it does catch, only a crew heal puts the fire out.
check.counteredLine: You smother the blaze before it can spread.
check.failLine: The fire sale catches, and your hull goes up in flame.

phases.dialogueLine: You should have paid when the price was gold. Now it is your ship.

check.name: Total Liquidation
check.telegraph: The Quartermaster runs out every gun the Cache has left and levels them all at your hull.
check.counteredLine: You throw up cover and the last of his stock breaks against it.
check.failLine: Everything he had left lands at once.

special.name: Dig In
special.line: The Bank drops his weight into the silt and settles, and the shot just thumps into mud.

special.name: Deadwood
special.line: Root and deadwood come up under the hull and wrap the rudder, and the wheel goes dead in your hands.

special.name: Chain-Shot
special.line: Chain-shot screams through your powder line and your guns cough where they roared.

special.name: Hull-Cracker
special.line: A cracker round splits your seams wide open, and every blow after it will find the gap.

special.name: Old Wounds
special.line: Old Scar takes the hit the way he has taken every other one, and the hole closes while you watch.

special.name: Gag Order
special.line: The gag order comes down, and your crew go quiet mid-shout.

special.name: Still Water
special.line: Sal stops moving. The chop goes flat around him, and every gun on the line goes quiet.

phases.dialogueLine: The don said bring him your colors. He never said in one piece.

check.name: The Death Roll
check.telegraph: Sal takes your hull in his teeth, sets his feet against the swell, and starts to turn.
check.hint: He is going to roll, and he will not let go. Only a crew ability gets something between your hull and that grip. Your own brace or dodge does nothing here.
check.counteredLine: He rolls against braced timber, tears off a mouthful of nothing, and lets go spitting splinters.
check.failLine: He rolls, and he keeps rolling, and your hull comes apart along the grain.

phases.dialogueLine: You want the don? Then come through my back. Nothing you carry goes through my back. Not one shot of it.

ledger.name: The Ledger
ledger.description: He fights with everything he is still holding: your fire, your ice, your sights, your bearings. Take them back and he cannot use them on you again.

ironclad.name: Ironclad
ironclad.description: 50% chance to soak 30% off your shot.

vampiric.name: Vampiric
vampiric.description: 50% chance to repair 20% of the damage it deals you.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.description: Wreck explodes on sinking for 10% of your current HP.

fleet.name: Fleet
fleet.description: Heavy speed bonus. Usually acts before you each turn.

frenzied.name: Frenzied
frenzied.description: 33% chance to fire twice in one turn.

reflective.name: Reflective
reflective.description: 50% chance to reflect 15% of your damage back.

resilient.name: Resilient
resilient.description: 33% chance to repair 5 HP at the start of its turn.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.description: Doubles its crit chance against you.

scorching.name: Scorching
scorching.description: 20% chance its shot sets you ablaze, burning for 2 turns.

glacial.name: Glacial
glacial.description: 20% chance its shot freezes you solid, costing your next turn.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: When it dodges your shot, it turns 50% of that blow back on you.

yawing.name: Yawing
yawing.description: Never holds a line. Your target band slides across the aim bar much faster.

warded.name: Warded
warded.description: Behind a barrier worth 30% of its hull that soaks your shots before its health. Break it first. (Burn bleeds through; the Railgun pierces it.)

pool.title: A Drifting Wreck
pool.flavor: Half a hull no flag claims, dredged from somewhere deeper than these waters should reach.

choices.label: Strip the hold
choices.description: +10% crit chance all run. Enemies hit you 10% harder all run.

choices.label: Take the medical chest
choices.description: Heal 18% of your max HP now. Costs you 50 ⟡ at raid end.

choices.label: Sail past
choices.description: Nothing happens. Clean wake.

pool.title: A Sounding Bell
pool.flavor: A bell tolls through the fog. Either an open invitation, or a trap meant to herd you onto someone's guns.

choices.label: Follow the bell
choices.description: It leads to a half-sunk cache: +150 ⟡ at raid end. But the chase leaves you ragged. You enter the boss fight with 8% less HP.

choices.label: Hold your course
choices.description: Nothing happens. The safe heading.

choices.label: Sail wide of the bell
choices.description: +15% Volley damage in the boss fight. The long way around runs the crew ragged. You enter the boss with 10% less HP.

pool.title: Empty Powder Keg
pool.flavor: A black-powder cask bobs alongside, lid half-off. Useful to the right captain. Dangerous to the careless one.

choices.label: Refill stores
choices.description: Every reload has a 10% chance to load +1 cannonball, all run. Enter the next fight with 8% less HP.

choices.label: Rig it as a one-shot
choices.description: Next enemy starts at 65% HP. Rigging the blast leaves your hull wide open. You take 20% more damage that fight.

choices.label: Heave it overboard
choices.description: 1 guaranteed dodge next fight (no roll needed). Heaving it took the crew off the rail. You enter that fight with 6% less HP.

pool.title: A Bottle in the Surf
pool.flavor: A captain's log fragment, water-stained, readable. From someone who didn't make the next port.

choices.label: Read it
choices.description: Gold crit zone is 5% wider all run. Enter the next fight with 8% less HP (wheel went unattended).

choices.label: Pocket the bottle
choices.description: +150 ⟡ at raid end. Reading it under way, you let the watch slip. You enter the next fight with 8% less HP.

choices.label: Toss it back
choices.description: Nothing happens. The bottle drifts on.

pool.title: A Wounded Whale
pool.flavor: Entangled in Finndicate netting, dragging the lines deeper.

choices.label: Cut it loose
choices.description: +10% Volley damage all run. The freed whale thrashes through your lines. -2 ship speed for the next 2 fights.

choices.label: Harvest it
choices.description: +10% Fire damage all run. -10% dodge next fight (cries draw attention).

choices.label: Take only the netting
choices.description: +2 cannonballs at the start of the next fight. Hauling it aboard leaves the rail exposed. Enter that fight with 5% less HP.

pool.title: A Foggy Crosswind
pool.flavor: The wind shifts hard against the current. The fog bows but does not lift.

choices.label: Trim sails for speed
choices.description: +15% Fire damage all run. -2 ship speed for the next 2 fights.

choices.label: Stay the course
choices.description: Nothing happens. No trade either way.

choices.label: Drop the sea anchor
choices.description: Take 12% less damage all run. Riding low and cautious blunts your guns. -8% damage all run.

pool.title: A Sheltered Cove
pool.flavor: A driftwood inlet behind a rock-spit. Calm water, no enemy sails in sight. A captain could put in here.

choices.label: Beach the ship and patch the hull
choices.description: Full HP restored. But the long stop leaves your gun crews rusty. -12% damage all run.

choices.label: Quick patch in the bow
choices.description: Heal 18% of your max HP now. You enter the boss fight with 10% less HP.

choices.label: Sail on
choices.description: Nothing happens. Save your hull for whatever is ahead.

pool.title: A Damage-Control Drill
pool.flavor: The bo`sun wants a half-hour for the crew. The water around you is empty enough that he might be right.

choices.label: Live-fire drill
choices.description: +6% crit chance all run. The powder spent drilling leaves you thin. You enter the next fight with 5% less HP.

choices.label: Damage-control rehearsal
choices.description: Heal 4% of your max HP at the start of every remaining fight. The crew drills patches, not gunnery. -10% Fire damage all run.

choices.label: Skip the drill
choices.description: Nothing happens. Save the time.

pool.title: A Maelstrom's Pull
pool.flavor: The sea opens a slow gray throat off the bow. Ride its edge and it will hurl you forward, or swallow you whole.

choices.label: Ride the current
choices.description: +16% damage all run. Enemies hit you 20% harder all run.

choices.label: Brace and bail
choices.description: Heal 30% of your max HP now. Costs you 100 ⟡ at raid end.

choices.label: Sail wide
choices.description: Nothing happens. Clean wake.

pool.title: The Drowned Armory
pool.flavor: A sunken man-o-war's gun deck, still stocked, the powder somehow dry. Take what the sea was keeping.

choices.label: Load the heavy shot
choices.description: +18% Fire damage all run. The heavy rounds are a slow, back-breaking load. -2 ship speed all run.

choices.label: Haul the powder aboard
choices.description: Every reload has a 20% chance to load +1 cannonball, all run. The extra powder weighs the hull down. -1 ship speed all run.

choices.label: Bolt on the hull plate
choices.description: Take 22% less damage all run. The added weight slows your guns. -12% damage all run.

pool.title: A Siren's Bargain
pool.flavor: A voice in the swell offers a trade, sweet and certain. Bargains struck on open water are always paid in full.

choices.label: Sing back
choices.description: +12% crit chance all run. Enemies hit you 15% harder all run.

choices.label: Take the song
choices.description: Full HP restored. But the bargain is paid in full. You take 12% more damage all run.

choices.label: Sail past
choices.description: Nothing happens. Hold the line.

pool.title: The King Tide
pool.flavor: The whole sea heaves at once, a wave with no weather behind it. Time it right and it carries you onto the boss like a battering ram.

choices.label: Crest the wave
choices.description: +25% damage in the boss fight. Riding the crest in slams you against the hull. You enter the boss with 12% less HP.

choices.label: Heal in the trough
choices.description: Heal 6% of your max HP at the start of every remaining fight. -15% Volley damage all run.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.description: +2 Initiative all run (fire first and flee more reliably). The hard heel into the swell strains the seams. Take 12% more damage all run.

pool.title: A Ghost Convoy
pool.flavor: A line of ships rides the horizon, lanterns lit, no crew at the rails. They hold formation as if still waiting on orders.

choices.label: Board the lead ship
choices.description: The next enemy starts at half HP. You take 15% more damage that fight.

choices.label: Fall in behind them
choices.description: +2 guaranteed dodges next fight (no roll needed). Drifting in their cold wake saps the crew. Enter that fight with 8% less HP.

choices.label: Let them sail on
choices.description: Nothing happens. Some things are best left to the fog.

reprieve.title: The Don's Gift
reprieve.flavor: Don Finleone waves the court back and looks you over, unimpressed. "Half-sunk already? No, no. I did not swim up from the deep to gut some wounded little thing. Patch yourself. Load your guns. Wake a hand. Make this worth my while."

choices.label: Patch the hull
choices.description: Heal 20% of your max HP before the fight.

choices.label: Sharpen the guns
choices.description: +5% damage for the fight ahead.

choices.label: Wake a hand
choices.description: Refresh one spent crew ability, ready for the don.

raidItems.name: Corsair Cannon
raidItems.description: +10% damage to raid bosses.
raidItems.source: Barnacle Pete's Raid

raidItems.name: Corsair's Prime Cannon
raidItems.description: +20% damage to raid bosses. The captain-grade version of the Corsair Cannon.
raidItems.source: Barnacle Pete's Raid

raidItems.name: Quartermaster's Anchor
raidItems.description: Once per raid, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead of sinking. Raids only, never skirmishes.
raidItems.source: Quartermaster's Cache

raidItems.name: Navigator's Compass
raidItems.description: Adds 20% of your Savvy to your turn-order roll, so you strike first more often.
raidItems.source: Quartermaster's Cache

raidItems.name: Krust's Carapace
raidItems.description: Cuts incoming enemy fire by 10%.
raidItems.source: Krust's Consignment

raidItems.name: Captain's Carapace
raidItems.description: Cuts incoming enemy fire by 15%. The plated hide Krust himself hid behind for years.
raidItems.source: Krust's Consignment

raidItems.name: Gunner's Sight
raidItems.description: +15% damage on critical hits, but non-critical shots hit for 15% less. A trade for the steady-handed.
raidItems.source: Driftwood Cache

raidItems.name: Reinforced Hull
raidItems.description: +15% max HP at the start of every raid. Heavier strakes, slower to sink.
raidItems.source: Driftwood Cache

raidItems.name: Incendiary Cannonball
raidItems.description: Each hit has a 15% chance to set the enemy ablaze, burning them for 2 turns (damage scaled to the hit that lit them).
raidItems.source: The Sunken Cache

raidItems.name: Frozen Cannonball
raidItems.description: Each hit has a 15% chance to freeze the enemy solid, making them lose their next turn.
raidItems.source: The Sunken Cache

raidItems.name: Spet's Primer
raidItems.description: 50% chance to start each raid fight with a cannonball already loaded, so you can fire on the opening bell.
raidItems.source: The Tollmaster's Cut

raidItems.name: Tollmaster's Primer
raidItems.description: Always start each raid fight with a cannonball already loaded. The Tollmaster never waits to take his cut.
raidItems.source: The Tollmaster's Cut

raidItems.name: Cartographer's Astrolabe
raidItems.description: On a successful dodge, 30% chance to deflect 50% of the incoming shot back at the attacker.
raidItems.source: The Cartographer's Survey

raidItems.name: Mastercraft Astrolabe
raidItems.description: On a successful dodge, 50% chance to deflect 75% of the incoming shot back at the attacker. The Cartographer's own brass instrument, machined to a finer tolerance than any other in his cabin.
raidItems.source: The Cartographer's Survey

raidItems.name: Chain-Shot Rack
raidItems.description: Landed hits have a 25% chance to fire a spread that tears both rigging and plating. WEAKENED: it deals 20% less damage. CORRODED: its barrier takes 30% more damage. Both for 2 rounds. Sal Brackwater's own answer, turned back on the Finndicate.
raidItems.source: The Blockade: Sal Brackwater

raidItems.name: Brackwater Rack
raidItems.description: Landed hits have a 35% chance to fire a spread of scrap iron. WEAKENED: it deals 20% less damage. CORRODED: its barrier takes 30% more damage. FEEBLE: it takes 20% more damage. All three, for 2 rounds. Sal's own rack, hauled off his wreck and turned around.
raidItems.source: The Blockade: Sal Brackwater

raidItems.name: The Court's Fang
raidItems.description: A tooth pried from one of the don’s court. On a CRITICAL hit, 20% chance to tear a loaded cannonball clean off the enemy’s rack, delaying its next shot.
raidItems.source: The Throne: Don Finleone

raidItems.name: The Don's Signet
raidItems.description: The ring every captain in the Finndicate answered to, and every gun in his court. On a CRITICAL hit, the command turns against them: 50% chance to tear a loaded cannonball off the enemy’s rack, delaying its next shot.
raidItems.source: The Throne: Don Finleone

raidItems.name: The Primeval Maw
raidItems.description: The oldest teeth in the sea, cut back out of what wore them and bolted to your hull. It gains a TIER for every stretch of Fishing XP you earn while it is mounted, and each tier keeps everything the tiers below it unlocked. Six in all.
raidItems.source: The Sunken Hand

raidItems.name: Davy's Heavy Cannon
raidItems.description: Your damage climbs +5% every turn of a fight (resets when the next enemy draws alongside). Long fights end ugly for them.
raidItems.source: The Davy Jones Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Davy's Hand Cannon
raidItems.description: +20% damage to non-boss enemies. Tears through a crew before the captain ever shows his colors.
raidItems.source: The Davy Jones Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Davy's Grand Cannon
raidItems.description: Both Davy cannons forged onto one mount: damage climbs +4% each turn of a fight AND +17% damage to non-boss enemies. Tuned down a hair to share a single carriage.
raidItems.source: Forged from Davy's Heavy + Hand Cannon

raidItems.name: Davy's Blood Cannon
raidItems.description: The gun drinks every wound it opens: you heal 8% of the damage you deal. The deep gives nothing back but what you take by force.
raidItems.source: Hardcore · The Davy Jones Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Bloodletter
raidItems.description: The blood gun wed to the long ramp: you heal 8% of the damage you deal AND your damage climbs +4% every turn of a fight. Bleed them slow.
raidItems.source: Forged from Davy's Blood + Heavy Cannon

raidItems.name: Reaver's Cannon
raidItems.description: Heal 8% of the damage you deal and hit non-boss enemies for +17%. Reave through a crew and drink the whole time.
raidItems.source: Forged from Davy's Blood + Hand Cannon

raidItems.name: Vanguard Battery
raidItems.description: Your FIRST shot of every fight lands for +30% damage, and every shot after is normal. The vanguard gun runs hot off the first pull, so lead with a loaded volley or Mega and open heavy.
raidItems.source: Don's Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Dampener Plate
raidItems.description: When a single hit would take more than 25% of your max hull, there is a 50% chance the plating dampens it back down to 25%. It blunts the heaviest blows, but the slow bleed still gets through.
raidItems.source: Don's Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Carrion Sight
raidItems.description: You deal +25% damage to any enemy already suffering a status: burning, frozen, weakened, corroded, or any hex you laid on it. The glass finds the crack in a hull that is already breaking.
raidItems.source: Don's Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Siege Cannon
raidItems.description: +17% damage to bosses AND your damage climbs +4% every turn of a fight. Built for the long guns against a heavy hull.
raidItems.source: Forged from Corsair's Prime Cannon + Davy's Heavy Cannon

raidItems.name: Sharpshooter's Cannon
raidItems.description: +17% damage to non-boss enemies AND +13% critical damage, but non-crit shots hit for 13% less. A crew-shredder for the steady-handed.
raidItems.source: Forged from Davy's Hand Cannon + Gunner's Sight

raidItems.name: Warlord's Cannon
raidItems.description: +17% damage to bosses AND +13% critical damage, but non-crit shots hit for 13% less. The killing piece for a captain who lands his crits.
raidItems.source: Forged from Corsair's Prime Cannon + Gunner's Sight

raidItems.name: Ironclad Bulwark
raidItems.description: +15% max HP AND cuts incoming enemy fire by 15%. Heavier strakes over the captain-grade plated hide.
raidItems.source: Forged from Reinforced Hull + Captain's Carapace

raidItems.name: Last Bastion
raidItems.description: Once per raid, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead of sinking, AND +15% max HP. The hull that refuses the deep.
raidItems.source: Forged from Quartermaster's Anchor + Reinforced Hull

raidItems.name: Deflector Plate
raidItems.description: On a successful dodge, 50% chance to deflect 75% of the shot back at the attacker, AND cuts incoming enemy fire by 15%.
raidItems.source: Forged from Mastercraft Astrolabe + Captain's Carapace

raidItems.name: Vanguard's Chronometer
raidItems.description: Adds 20% of your Savvy to your turn-order roll so you strike first more often, AND always opens each fight with a cannonball already loaded.
raidItems.source: Forged from Navigator's Compass + Tollmaster's Primer

raidItems.name: Marauder's Cannon
raidItems.description: +17% damage to bosses AND +17% damage to non-boss enemies. One gun that tears through anything under your sights.
raidItems.source: Forged from Corsair's Prime Cannon + Davy's Hand Cannon

raidItems.name: Dreadnought Cannon
raidItems.description: +17% damage to bosses AND cuts incoming enemy fire by 15%. A heavy gun on a heavier hull, so trade blows with a captain and walk away.
raidItems.source: Forged from Corsair's Prime Cannon + Captain's Carapace

raidItems.name: Bastion Primer
raidItems.description: Cuts incoming enemy fire by 15% AND always opens each fight with a cannonball already loaded. Weather the first blow, answer with your own.
raidItems.source: Forged from Captain's Carapace + Tollmaster's Primer

raidItems.name: Riposte Chronometer
raidItems.description: On a successful dodge, 50% chance to deflect 75% of the shot back at the attacker, AND always open each fight with a cannonball already loaded. Slip the blow and return it.
raidItems.source: Forged from Mastercraft Astrolabe + Tollmaster's Primer

raidItems.name: Tell-Tale Glass
raidItems.description: When an enemy would dodge your shot, 20% chance to read the feint and land it anyway.
raidItems.source: Admiral Ruse's Coffers

raidItems.name: Admiral's Eye
raidItems.description: When an enemy would dodge your shot, 35% chance to read the feint and land it anyway.
raidItems.source: Admiral Ruse's Coffers

raidItems.name: War Drum
raidItems.description: Once per raid: beat the drum for a 40% chance to restore a random spent crew ability. Fires from the Special menu and does not cost your turn.
raidItems.source: The Quartermaster's Cache

raidItems.name: Thunder Drum
raidItems.description: Once per raid: beat the drum to restore a random spent crew ability, guaranteed. Fires from the Special menu and does not cost your turn.
raidItems.source: The Quartermaster's Cache

raidItems.name: Crow's-Nest Rigging
raidItems.description: Each of your normal hits has a 15% chance to become a critical hit for much bigger damage.
raidItems.source: The Quartermaster's Cache

raidItems.name: Trade-Wind Sails
raidItems.description: Each time you reload, a 15% chance to load 2 cannonballs at once instead of 1.
raidItems.source: The Quartermaster's Cache

raidItems.name: Emberfrost Cannonball
raidItems.description: Each hit has an 18% chance to set the enemy ablaze for 2 turns, and an 18% chance to freeze them solid and cost them their next turn. Both can land on the same shot.
raidItems.source: Forged from the Incendiary + Frozen Cannonball

raidItems.name: Deadman's Bearing
raidItems.description: Adds 25% of your Savvy to your turn-order roll, and once per raid a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead of sinking. Strike first, and refuse to go down.
raidItems.source: Forged from the Quartermaster's Anchor + Navigator's Compass

raidItems.name: Heavy Gunner's Sight
raidItems.description: +18% critical damage and +12% max HP, and none of the Sight’s non-crit penalty. The same steady hands, behind heavier strakes.
raidItems.source: Forged from the Gunner's Sight + Reinforced Hull

raidItems.name: Leviathan's Cannon
raidItems.description: +30% damage to bosses, your damage climbs +4% every turn of a fight, every critical hit advances that climb by one more turn, and +13% critical damage at the cost of 10% off your non-crits. The siege gun and the warlord’s piece welded into one barrel.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Siege Cannon + Warlord's Cannon

raidItems.name: Aegis of the Deep
raidItems.description: +15% max HP, cuts incoming enemy fire by 25%, on a successful dodge a 50% chance to deflect 75% of the shot back at the attacker, and a 35% chance the first blow of every fight is turned aside outright. Nothing the deep throws reaches the hull clean.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Ironclad Bulwark + Deflector Plate

raidItems.name: Drowned Crown
raidItems.description: +17% damage to bosses AND non-boss enemies, +15% max HP, and once per raid a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead of sinking. Cheat death that way and you deal a further +10% to elite hulls for the rest of the fight. The crown that will not be taken.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Marauder's Cannon + Last Bastion

raidItems.name: Tempest Chronometer
raidItems.description: Adds 20% of your Savvy to your turn-order roll, opens every fight with a cannonball loaded and a 50% chance of loading a second, and on a successful dodge a 50% chance to deflect 75% of the shot back. Strike first, and answer everything.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Vanguard's Chronometer + Riposte Chronometer

raidItems.name: Carrion Rack
raidItems.description: 30% chance each hit to Weaken, Corrode and make the enemy Feeble, and you deal +21% damage to anything already suffering a status. It opens the wound and twists it.
raidItems.source: Forged from Carrion Sight + Brackwater Rack

raidItems.name: Ambush Signet
raidItems.description: Your first shot each fight lands +26% harder, and a critical hit has a 45% chance to tear a loaded cannonball off the enemy. Open loud, and disarm them while they reel.
raidItems.source: Forged from Vanguard Battery + The Don's Signet

raidItems.name: Bastion Drum
raidItems.description: A single hit over 25% of your max hull has a 50% chance to be dampened back to it, and once per raid you can beat the drum to bring a spent crew ability back. Hold the line, then rally.
raidItems.source: Forged from Dampener Plate + Thunder Drum

raidItems.name: Hawkeye Glass
raidItems.description: A 30% chance to see through a feint and land a shot the enemy would have dodged, and a 13% chance any clean hit sharpens into a crit. Nothing slips the glass.
raidItems.source: Forged from Admiral's Eye + Crow's-Nest Rigging

raidItems.name: Predator's Battery
raidItems.description: Your first shot each fight lands +26% harder, and you deal +21% damage to any enemy already suffering a status. Pick the wounded, and open on them hard.
raidItems.source: Forged from Vanguard Battery + Carrion Sight

raidItems.name: Rally Rigging
raidItems.description: Each reload has a 15% chance to catch the wind and load a second cannonball, and once per raid you can rally a spent crew ability back to the line. Never lose your tempo.
raidItems.source: Forged from Trade-Wind Sails + Thunder Drum

raidItems.name: Plague Cannon
raidItems.description: 35% chance each hit to Weaken, Corrode and make the enemy Feeble, with a further 25% chance a critical hit lands all three on its own. You deal +25% damage to anything afflicted, and your criticals hit +15% harder. A rotting hull dies screaming.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Carrion Rack + Sharpshooter's Cannon

raidItems.name: Warden of the Deep
raidItems.description: A big hit has a 60% chance to be dampened to 25% of your hull, every hit that does reach you has a 20% chance to load a cannonball, the first killing blow each raid leaves you standing, 25% of your Savvy joins your turn-order roll, and once per raid you rally a spent ability. The deep does not let you fall.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Bastion Drum + Deadman’s Bearing

raidItems.name: Oracle's Eye
raidItems.description: A 35% chance to see through a feint, and a shot that slips through one lands as a critical. An 18% chance a clean hit becomes a crit, criticals hit +20% harder, and +12% max hull. You see the shot before it is taken.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Hawkeye Glass + Heavy Gunner's Sight

raidItems.name: Warlord's Reckoning
raidItems.description: Your first shot each fight lands +35% harder, and against a boss every new phase counts as a fresh opening shot. A crit has a 50% chance to strip a loaded cannonball, and you deal +22% to bosses AND non-bosses alike. When you open, the account is already settled.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Ambush Signet + Marauder's Cannon

raidItems.name: Don's Palisade
raidItems.description: Opens every fight behind a barrier worth 12% of your hull, and every Reload braces 50% of it back. The Don does not need to be there for it to hold.
raidItems.source: Hardcore · Don's Gauntlet

raidItems.name: Palisade Bulwark
raidItems.description: Opens every fight behind a barrier worth 16% of your hull and braces 50% of it back on every Reload, and a single hit over 25% of your max hull has a 50% chance to be dampened back to it. The chip and the haymaker, both answered.
raidItems.source: Forged from Don's Palisade + Dampener Plate

raidItems.name: The Standing Wall
raidItems.description: Opens every fight behind a barrier worth 22% of your hull and braces 60% of it back on every Reload, a single hit over 25% of your max hull has a 50% chance to be dampened back to it, +15% max hull, and once per raid a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead of sinking with the barrier restored to full. A wall does not fall twice.
raidItems.source: Abyssal Forge: Palisade Bulwark + Last Bastion

list.name: Railgun
list.tagline: A piercing lance of light that always finds its mark.
list.flavor: A lance of light off the gun deck. Nothing the deep can do to slip it.
list.identity: The sure thing. It never fully misses.
perks: Can't be fully dodged — even a clean dodge only grazes it (still ~55% damage), never a whiff.
Armor-piercing — no plate or carapace can soak or deflect it.
The most reliable ultimate: it always lands something.
— Lowest raw multiplier of the three (that certainty is the trade).

list.name: Barrage
list.tagline: The whole broadside loosed at once — four hammer-blows in a heartbeat.
list.flavor: The whole broadside loosed in a heartbeat. Four hammer-blows where one fell before.
list.identity: The combo weapon. It triggers everything you carry.
perks: Strikes four times in one blow instead of once.
Every hit re-rolls your on-hit effects (burn, freeze, sunder) — the first at full odds, the rest reduced.
Best on a proc-heavy loadout: the more on-hit gear you run, the harder it hits.
— Can be dodged, though a dodge only shaves part of the volley, not all of it.

list.name: Nuke
list.tagline: One devastating blast that leaves the wreck burning for turns.
list.flavor: You light the powder of a hundred ships at once. What it touches does not stay afloat.
list.identity: The finisher. Nothing else hits this hard.
perks: By far the highest damage of the three on a clean hit.
Leaves the target burning — Fallout deals extra damage for 3 turns after the blast.
The all-out swing: your best answer to a boss you need dead now.
— All-or-nothing: it can be dodged, and a dodge wastes the entire shot.

story.unlockBlurb: The Coffers held more than doubloons. Buried in the Quartermaster's cache were schematics no honest shipwright would draw: plans for a weapon meant to end a fight in a single breath. The plans are yours now. Building one will cost a fortune and the better part of a day, but the ship that carries it answers to no one.
story.buildBlurb: Raise one signature Mega blow into your hull, forged from the Quartermaster's stolen plans. It fires above your Volley for a full magazine of {charges} cannonballs, then leaves you cold.
story.buildingLine: Your shipwrights work the plans day and night. You can still change which weapon they raise until the work is done.
story.retoolingLine: Your shipwrights strip the mounts and raise the new weapon. {current} stays armed until the work is done.
story.schematicsBlurb: You built one weapon from a torn page. This is the whole book: every plan the Quartermaster ever stole, cover to cover. Own it and your shipwrights can swap your ultimate freely, any weapon, any time, no cost, no wait.
story.schematicsUnlockLine: Every page accounted for. The armory is yours now. Swap your ultimate whenever the fight calls for it.

master_gunner.name: Master Gunner
master_gunner.tagline: Glass cannon. You hit hard. You also break.
master_gunner.description: Sacrifice hull integrity for raw firepower. Cannons run hotter, plating is thinner.

ironside.name: Ironside
ironside.tagline: Plate and patience. You outlast everything.
ironside.description: Reinforced everywhere. Your hull soaks more, your guns sit a little lighter.

helmsman.name: Helmsman
helmsman.description: You sail for the prize, not the glory. Heavier holds full of plunder cost you tempo.

buccaneer.name: Buccaneer
buccaneer.description: A small lift across the board for the captain who wants their options open. The default pirate, just a little better at everything.

master_gunner_ii.name: Master Gunner II
master_gunner_ii.tagline: Deeper into the bargain. Hotter still.
master_gunner_ii.description: You lean further into the gunner's trade. Even more bite, even less plate. Stacks on your Master Gunner.

ironside_ii.name: Ironside II
ironside_ii.tagline: Plate over plate. You will not sink.
ironside_ii.description: Reinforce what was already reinforced. Your hull soaks more; your guns sit lighter still. Stacks on your Ironside.

helmsman_ii.name: Helmsman II
helmsman_ii.description: More of the prize, more of the drag. You sail heavier and richer. Stacks on your Helmsman.

buccaneer_ii.name: Buccaneer II
buccaneer_ii.tagline: A little better at everything. Again.
buccaneer_ii.description: Another small lift across the board for the captain who keeps their options open. Stacks on your Buccaneer.

master_gunner_iii.name: Master Gunner III
master_gunner_iii.description: The gunner's trade as far as it goes. A smaller final gain than before, but the plate keeps thinning. Stacks on your Master Gunner II.

ironside_iii.name: Ironside III
ironside_iii.tagline: An anvil the sea cannot crack.
ironside_iii.description: Plate on plate on plate. All but unsinkable, and slow to answer. Stacks on your Ironside II.

helmsman_iii.name: Helmsman III
helmsman_iii.tagline: The richest hold on the water.
helmsman_iii.description: Every coin the sea offers, and the drag that comes with it. Stacks on your Helmsman II.

buccaneer_iii.name: Buccaneer III
buccaneer_iii.tagline: Better at everything. One last time.
buccaneer_iii.description: A final, lighter lift across the board for the captain who never specialized. Stacks on your Buccaneer II.

armory_expansion.name: Expanded Armory
armory_expansion.tagline: One more answer bolted to the deck.
armory_expansion.description: Refit the hold for one more raid-item mount. Every fight, one more piece of gear working for you.

crew_quarters.name: Expanded Quarters
crew_quarters.description: Your ship berths one more crew — raids AND voyages sail a body heavier.

crewSkins.name: Molten Maw
crewSkins.blurb: Breaching from a sea of fire.

crewSkins.name: Spectral

crewSkins.name: Hunter's Bane
crewSkins.blurb: The whale that hunts the hunters.

crewSkins.name: Ancient

crewSkins.name: Cursed
crewSkins.blurb: Hexed whiskers, humming with old magic.

crewSkins.name: Prismatic
crewSkins.blurb: Every color of the abyss at once.

crewSkins.name: Galaxy

crewSkins.name: High Roller

crewSkins.name: Wraithfin

crewSkins.name: Tempest

crewSkins.name: Deadeye

crewSkins.name: Golden Relic

crewSkins.name: Undying

crewSkins.name: Fossil

crewSkins.name: Corsair Queen
crewSkins.blurb: She took a crown off the sea and dared it to ask for it back.

crewSkins.name: Golden Command
crewSkins.blurb: Gold braid, colder eyes. The fleet answers before she finishes the order.

crewSkins.name: Cursed Ghost
crewSkins.blurb: A haunt in the fog, marking names the living cannot read.

crewSkins.name: The Idol
crewSkins.blurb: The rarest catch in the sea, worshipped and feared. Hold her gaze and you are already marked.

crewSkins.name: Blood Tide
crewSkins.blurb: The hunt turns the water red.

crewSkins.name: Kingpin
crewSkins.blurb: Boss of the reef. Everyone pays up.

crewSkins.name: Captain
crewSkins.blurb: Squishy, unbothered, and somehow in command of the whole reef.

crewSkins.name: Party Blob
crewSkins.blurb: First to the grog, last to leave the deck.

crewSkins.name: Sailor
crewSkins.blurb: Salt in the veins, one eye on the horizon.

crewSkins.name: Dealer
crewSkins.blurb: The house always bites back.

crewSkins.name: Bard
crewSkins.blurb: A tune for every tide, a tale for every scar.

crewSkins.name: Tavernkeeper
crewSkins.blurb: The grog never runs dry on this watch.

crewSkins.name: Aristocrat
crewSkins.blurb: Old money runs deep in these waters.

crewSkins.name: Royalty
crewSkins.blurb: Crowned by the current, bowed to by the reef.

crewSkins.name: Potion Master
crewSkins.blurb: A different brew on every spine.

crewSkins.name: Crimson Cavalier
crewSkins.blurb: En garde. Venom on every point.

crewSkins.name: Manny Jones
crewSkins.blurb: Keeper of the reef's own locker.

crewSkins.name: Spectral
crewSkins.blurb: A shadow gliding just past the light.

crewSkins.name: Royal Nurse
crewSkins.blurb: Mends the crew, rules the ward.

crewSkins.name: Plague Doctor
crewSkins.blurb: The beak keeps the miasma at bay.

crewSkins.name: Frozen
crewSkins.blurb: Locked in the ice of the deep cold.

crewSkins.name: Collector
crewSkins.blurb: Every lost trinket finds its way home.

crewSkins.name: Overdrive
crewSkins.blurb: Past the horizon before the wake catches up.

crewSkins.name: Opulent
crewSkins.blurb: Sailing first-class, always.

crewSkins.name: Punk Rock
crewSkins.blurb: Mohawk fin, blown speakers, zero chill.

crewSkins.name: Cavalier
crewSkins.blurb: One thrust, one duel, one winner.

crewSkins.name: Afterlife
crewSkins.blurb: Drifting on from the far shore.

crewSkins.name: Enforcer
crewSkins.blurb: Gentle giant? Not today.

crewSkins.name: Detective
crewSkins.blurb: Every current tells a story to a sharp eye.

crewSkins.name: Storm Chaser
crewSkins.blurb: Where the storm breaks, she is already there.

crewSkins.name: Royalty
crewSkins.blurb: Born to rule the pod, crowned by the tide.

crewSkins.name: Embermaw
crewSkins.blurb: Jaws lit like coals from the deep.

crewSkins.name: Warlord
crewSkins.blurb: Battle-scarred and unbeaten.

crewSkins.name: Crimson
crewSkins.blurb: Striped in fresh blood, and hungry for more.

crewSkins.name: Blood Baron
crewSkins.blurb: Old blood, and plenty of it.

crewSkins.name: Ghastly
crewSkins.blurb: A pale terror drifting up from the dark.

crewSkins.name: Eldritch
crewSkins.blurb: Something older than the deep wears its face.

crewSkins.name: Bulwark
crewSkins.blurb: The sea breaks on him and loses.

crewSkins.name: Songkeeper
crewSkins.blurb: Keeper of the old songs of the deep.

crewSkins.name: Opulent
crewSkins.blurb: Draped in gold, vast beyond counting.

crewSkins.name: Admiral
crewSkins.blurb: The fleet answers to his flag.

crewSkins.name: Golden Helmsman
crewSkins.blurb: The richest hand on the wheel.

crewSkins.name: Glacial
crewSkins.blurb: Carved from the ice of the farthest north.

crewSkins.name: Abyssal
crewSkins.blurb: Born where no light reaches.

crewSkins.name: Sorcerer
crewSkins.blurb: Ink and old magic in every arm.

crewSkins.name: Ghoul
crewSkins.blurb: Risen gray and hungry from the black.

crewSkins.name: Ghost Relic
crewSkins.blurb: Bleached bone and old ghosts.

crewSkins.name: Iceborn
crewSkins.blurb: Forged in the coldest deep.

crewSkins.name: Blackout
crewSkins.blurb: A shadow with teeth. You never see it coming.

crewSkins.name: Archangel
crewSkins.blurb: Wings of light, judgment in every feather.

crewSkins.name: Fallen Angel
crewSkins.blurb: Grace turned to grievance. Halo swapped for horns.

crewSkins.name: Gilded Saint
crewSkins.blurb: Haloed in gold, worshipped by the whole reef.

crewSkins.name: Ancient Spirit
crewSkins.blurb: A soul adrift since the first tides.

crewSkins.name: Arcanist
crewSkins.blurb: Old spells hum in every tendril.

crewSkins.name: Blizzard
crewSkins.blurb: A frozen drift out of the deep cold.
