then.they: ... Okay. That didn't happen. Bruh. Anyway. Yooooo, earnings are next week, are you playing it? LOL. Moving on.

pell.they: Okay so delta runs from zero to one on a call, negative one to zero on a put. A fifty delta call moves about fifty cents per dollar the stock moves, and it's roughly the market's guess at the odds it finishes in the money. Dude, deep in the money it acts like stock, way out of the money it's a lottery ticket. Bruh, that's delta.

Theta is the rent. Dude, every day you hold an option you pay a little, and it speeds up as expiry gets close, like the last week is brutal. Buyers pay theta, sellers collect it. Bruh, most people out here are buyers and they don't know they're the rent.
Reorg? Lack of funds? Idk. Big ripperoni.
I don't even remember. I own so much stock. But all of them are worthless.

pell.you: What is the deal with earnings?
pell.they: Okay so before earnings, implied volatility gets pumped, the options get expensive, everybody's pricing the move. Then the number drops and IV crushes, like collapses, and your call can be right on direction and still lose because you paid for the fear. Dude, the price of the straddle divided by the stock price is roughly the move the market expects. If you don't think it beats that, you don't play it. Bruh, I play it anyway.
Bro i have no clue. I don't want to. But it's not looking good for me.
I should've invested in the Ancient Deep at a young, young age. Who knew that those fish prices would go insane...

pell.you: Would you consider me a close friend?
pell.they: Yeah, dude. You're, like, the best *voice crack* ...

Gamma is how much delta moves when the stock moves a dollar, so it's the thing that makes a position feel alive. Highest at the money right before expiry, dude, that's where an option flips from nothing to everything on a small move. Sellers are short gamma and it's the thing that eats them. Bruh, the data God has been eaten. Ripperoni.

marlow.they: Because you came anyway. That is the whole business model.
Fixed by the distance you just sailed. I only read it out.
Not in nine years. The harbor and I agreed to stop pretending.
Darker water and better prices. Both get worse the further you go.
Three. Two picked clean. I said I would not tell you which two and I meant it.
I did. I was terrible. It is why I am very good at buying.

marlow.you: Who was the captain you paid badly?
marlow.they: Her name was Tarn. She took it without a word, which was worse than shouting.
Every time somebody new pulls alongside. That is what a regret is for.

marlow.you: What is in the eastern wreck?
marlow.they: Something I have been keeping for whoever came out here often enough to deserve it. Do not go looking yet.
Out here you do not stop. You stop being out here one day and somebody notices a week later.

fitch.they: Further than the chart says. Do not.
When it is quiet. It is always quiet.

fitch.you: What is the sound you mentioned?
fitch.they: You will know it. Everybody says the same thing afterwards and I will not spoil that.

fitch.you: Are you all right out here?
fitch.they: That is the first time anybody has asked me. Yes.
Ask me again when you have earned it.
Something patient. That is all you are getting.
Up there I could hear everybody at once. Down here it is one thing at a time.
For the right reason. Nobody has had one yet.

It is wound from the same dark that is over your head right now. Land a fish on it and you may fold the water once and bring up a different one from these depths instead. Better or worse. It does not promise you better.

fitch.you: Why would I want to undo a catch?
fitch.they: You would not, most times. You will know the time. It comes once a trip and you will feel it before you decide.

nance.they: Anything that comes up from down there. I stopped being surprised a long time ago.
Three this month. You are the third.
I do not have a word for it. That is what makes it the strangest.
No. Go carefully and come up often.
Older than everything you sailed past to get here. The reef included.
I weigh. Other people go down. That division has kept me alive.

nance.you: Tell me about the captain before me.
nance.they: Eleven years on this band. Never late, never careless. It did not matter in the end.

nance.you: What do you think the ancients are?
nance.they: Not fish. I have said so for twenty years and nobody has argued with me twice.
Every day. That is why I am still here and the brave ones are not.
Nothing. Keep coming up. That is the whole of it and it is harder than it sounds.
It is a blade, and it is lit. Down here that is not decoration. The fish come to it, and they come fast - most casts take before your line has finished falling.
Because you keep coming back up. That is the entire test and almost nobody passes it.

yoon.you: Is the rod for sale?
yoon.they: Technically. Practically? Nah. Not yet.

yoon.you: What tier is it?
yoon.they: Twenty. Sheeeeesh, right? Doesn't matter though.

yoon.you: Why so far out?
yoon.they: Nobody sails this far for a rod they don't need. Gyattt, that's the filter.

yoon.you: What are you fishing for?
yoon.they: Nothing right now. Watching. Sheeeeesh, you can learn a lot watching.

yoon.you: Nice boat.
yoon.they: Bruhhh. It's a workbench with a sail. But thanks. Gucci.

yoon.you: What makes it different?
yoon.they: It doesn't waste a streak. That's it. That's the whole thing.

yoon.you: How much?
yoon.they: You'll know when you stop asking. Gyattt, everybody asks.

yoon.you: Do you ever fish for fun?
yoon.they: Every day. Making rods is the work part. Gyattt, fishing's the reason.

yoon.you: What is the worst rod you have made?
yoon.they: The first one. Snapped on a bluegill. Betty johnson. I kept the pieces.

yoon.you: Do you get lonely out here?
yoon.they: Lowkey? Sometimes. Then somebody like you shows up and I remember why I'm out here. Aight, don't make it weird.

yoon.you: How did you learn to make them?
yoon.they: Badly. For like six years. Then it clicked and I still couldn't tell you what changed.

yoon.you: What does locked in mean to you?
yoon.they: When you stop counting and you're just doing it. Gyattt, it's hard to explain.

yoon.you: What do you make of my rig?
yoon.they: Bruhhh. Too much dip on your chip. Half that setup is doing nothing and you are carrying it anyway.

yoon.you: What do you listen to out here?
yoon.they: The water. Gyattt, I know how that sounds. Also the water.

yoon.you: Why not sell in the harbor?
yoon.they: Because then anybody with coin gets it. That's not it. That was never it.

yoon.you: Do you miss making them?
yoon.they: Lowkey, yeah. But I said one rod and I meant one rod.

yoon.you: Am I overthinking this?
yoon.they: Bruhhh. Constantly. That is most of what is between you and the next one.

yoon.you: What happens after I buy it?
yoon.they: You fish. That's it. Gyattt, everybody thinks there's a next thing.

yoon.you: Was I ever close to failing?
yoon.they: Nah. Not once. You were locked in way earlier than you think.

yoon.you: Tell me about the rod. Properly.
yoon.they: It reads your streak and it grows with it. Perfect after perfect and the thing keeps getting stronger in your hands. Sheeeeesh.

yoon.you: And when I miss?
yoon.they: It drops back to nothing. All of it, one miss. That is not a punishment, bruhhh, that is the rod being honest about what you were doing.

brill.they: Ugly, right? The engine's new. I'd rather the boat looked like this than the other way round. Long story.

brill.you: Were you really on the expeditions?
brill.they: Six years. I have stories. I have SO many stories. Sit down or don't, they're coming either way. Oh we can only sit. They must've run out of budget for animating anything else.
Every day. Same spot. I like to think of it as my spawn point. Sorry. Games. I'll try to keep it under control. I'll probably forget, but I'll try!
A manual for a reel I don't own. It's fascinating. It's genuinely fascinating. Did you know that reels were invented 300-400 AD? That's old. I'm not old though.
Slow, which is fine, slow is the point, if I wanted fast I'd have stayed on the expeditions. That's a joke. It was mostly slow there too.
Everything. Too much. I once played a fishing game for three hundred hours and then bought a boat, so, you know. Draw your own conclusions.
It's the starting zone. All the best stories happen in the starting zone. At least that's what I tell myself.
Parts. The people, the stories, the being useful. Not the getting up. I still can't get up. Fishing lets you sit down. That's ninety percent of why.

brill.you: What was the three hundred hour game?
brill.they: A fishing game. I know. I know. I'm aware of the irony and I've made peace with it and then I bought a boat.

brill.you: Do you have family out here?
brill.they: No. Just the boat and, I guess, whoever stops. So, you, currently. Sorry, that got heavy. It doesn't have to be heavy.

brill.you: What were the expeditions actually like?
brill.they: Waiting. Ninety percent waiting. Then a very short amount of something. Then waiting about the something.
Once. In a dentist's chair. It was the worst twenty minutes of my life.
Oh, I have a forty-minute answer. Sit down. The short version is: cast where the water looks bored. The long version has diagrams.

brill.you: You seem to do all right for yourself.
brill.they: Do I? Good. That's the plan. Doing all right without it being a thing. I've spent more effort on that than on the fishing.
Patterns. And, honestly, so I have something to reread when it's quiet. The last column's the important one.

brill.you: What is the thing you are building?
brill.they: A place for green captains to ask forty-minute questions and get forty-minute answers. It has a name. I'm not ready to say the name.
Okay. Okay okay okay. Which decade? I'm kidding. Sort of. Sit down.

turbot.they: Three boats that did not come back up. Mind where you put that anchor.
It pays in rope. Occasionally it pays in better rope.
Not deep. Long. There is a difference and the long ones are worse.
Define good. I found a kettle last month and I have never been happier.
Still hanging. I have never rung it. I am not going to and neither are you.

turbot.you: Do you get frightened down there?
turbot.they: Only on the way up. On the way down you are working.
Ask me when you have earned it. I am not being coy, I am being careful.
She dives the deep band. Six years. Neither of us will be the one to send word first.

turbot.you: Why did you close the door again?
turbot.they: Because it had been shut on purpose, and I am not the one who gets to undo that.

turbot.you: Send her word. I will carry it.
turbot.they: You would, as well. Give me a season. I am nearly there.

ream.they: Anywhere on this sea. No charge. Yes, really.
More than you would think. Fewer than there were.
Meg is well, Matty is up if you use his numbers, Marlow is being Marlow. Nothing has changed in years.
Ask me when we know each other better. It is not a happy answer.

ream.you: Does anybody send word to Fitch?
ream.they: No. That is exactly why I go.

ream.you: What do they say about me?
ream.they: That you stop. Out here that is practically a reputation.
I carried word too slowly once. She was gone by the time it got there. That is the whole answer.
A captain. That is all I will say, and it is more than I have said to anybody.

ream.you: Who keeps the account when you stop?
ream.they: I was rather hoping you had been listening when I brought that up.

ream.you: What did Yoon nearly tell me?
ream.they: He said, and I quote, tell them they are locked in. Then he said forget it. So there you are.

moorings.name: Dennis
moorings.line: You are a real captain. Sorry. That was out loud.

moorings.name: Cass
moorings.line: Do not anchor here. I am working underneath you.

moorings.name: Rue
moorings.line: I carry word between the boats out here. No, there is no charge. That surprises everyone.

moorings.name: Meg
moorings.line: I kept the scale on this water for thirty years. Sit down anyway.

moorings.name: Matty
moorings.line: Fish don't keep and neither does my patience. Say something.

moorings.name: Marlow
moorings.line: Long way back to the dock from here. I've made a living out of exactly that.

moorings.name: Fitch
moorings.line: Not many come this deep. Sit.

moorings.name: Nance
moorings.line: You went down there and came back up. That is the part worth talking about.

moorings.name: Yoon
moorings.line: You've the streak for it, or you haven't. Rod won't teach you that. It just stops wasting it.

peddler: Shop prices are a shore thing. Out here I set them.
Bought too much, rowed too far. Your luck, not mine.
It is all worms in the end. Some of it is better worms.
I do not haggle and I do not wait. Yes or no.
salter: I have salt and barrels and no patience. What is in the hold?
Sell to me and it is done. Sell ashore and it is done Thursday.
Every fish you carry is a fish slowing you down.
I pay better than the quick lads on the dock. Not by much. But better.
tinker: Nobody comes out this far to buy worms. Good. I do not sell worms.
You are a long way from the beach. So am I. Let us both make it pay.
The dark is good for trade. Nobody follows you into it.
I have been out here longer than is sensible. I have the stock to show it.

personas.mood: In no hurry to be modest
lines: I have been further out than this. Much further. Ask anyone who was there.
Landed one once that took three of us and most of an afternoon.
Every mark on this hull has a story and a good number of them are true.
I could sail this stretch with my eyes shut. I have not. But I could.
You are looking at the second finest captain in these waters. The finest is modest about it.
They say the far water is dangerous. It was dangerous. I have been.
It was flat like this the morning the Margate went down. Flat exactly like this.
I check the hull twice before I leave and twice more when I am back.
Did you hear that? No? Good. Neither did I. Probably.
I keep a second rope. And a third. You can laugh, I have heard laughing before.
Everyone says it is fine out here. Everyone said that last season as well.
I do not go past the shelf. Nobody raised me brave, they raised me old.

personas.mood: A long way from the dock
lines: Three weeks out. My youngest will have grown and I will not know the face.
The tavern does a stew on the cold nights. I think about it more than is healthy.
You get used to the quiet. That is the part nobody warns you about.
I could turn for home. I say that at the start of every week.
There is a bunk ashore with my name on it and a mattress that remembers the shape of me.
Say something else. Anything. I am not fussy at this point.
Boats these days. All paint and no timber.
In my day you went and found the fish. Now you wait for them and complain about waiting.
I have no complaints. I have observations. There are a great many of them.
Everybody out here is in a hurry and not one of them is getting anywhere sooner.
They have gone and changed the market again. They are always changing the market.
Nothing wrong with the old way. Nothing wrong with it at all.
One day I am going to sail until the chart runs out and see what happens next.
I like the hour the light goes. Everything looks like it might be something else.
If I had a bigger boat I do not think I would fish at all. I would just go.
There is water past the water. There has to be.
I gave names to all the rocks on my usual run. None of the names took.
Some nights the whole sea holds still and you can believe it is listening.
Two boats went out together last week and one came back. They are not saying which.
You did not hear it from me, but somebody has been buying charts. All of them.
The Harbormaster has a new coat. Where does a Harbormaster come by a coat like that.
Everyone is very interested in the deep water lately. Everyone.
I do not repeat things. I say them once, to everybody.
There is a name going round that nobody says twice. I will not be the second one.
Second week. I have stopped being sick, which they tell me was the hard part.
I keep tying the knot wrong. It holds anyway. I have stopped asking why.
Everybody out here seems to know everybody. I am working on it.
I caught something yesterday and I do not know what it was. I put it back.
They said I would love it or be gone inside a month. I am still deciding.
How do you all know where you are? Everything looks the same to me out here.
I have not spoken to a soul in eleven days. You are doing very well so far.
The gulls have names now. I gave them the names. None of them objected.
What day is it. No. Do not tell me. I have come to like not knowing.
I talk to the boat. The boat is a marvelous listener and has never once interrupted.
You are the third real thing I have seen this week and the other two were weather.
I sang the whole way out. There was nobody to stop me and I checked.

hints: Chum's wasted in the shallows. Save it for water that's got something worth calling up.
A perfect reel pays more than a good one, and the second perfect in a row pays more again. Nobody tells you that.
Every stretch of water out here wants a different level off you. If it won't bite, you're early, not unlucky.
Your reel decides how fast the dial runs. Cheap reel, fast needle, and a hard fish is a coin toss.
The bigger your hold the longer you can stay out. That's the whole of it.
Sell to a buyer out here and you take less. Sail it home and the market pays every coin of it, on the spot.
A snag costs you bait on top of the fish. Some rods don't care. Worth knowing which.
If you're chasing size, keep casting the same water. Every species has a monster in it somewhere.
Every hook you buy widens the catch zone. Three degrees a tier. Doesn't sound like much until you've stacked five.
Bail on a fish you've already hooked and the streak dies with it. Stow the rod between casts and it keeps.
The Tide Turner lets you put a hooked fish back without the streak noticing. Comes off voyages, not out of a shop.
There's a hook out there that saves your bait a quarter of the time. Voyage reward. Worth the trip.
There's a rig that casts for you and opens what it finds. Ashore, in the tackle shop, for five thousand.
The Twin-Strike lands two at once, one cast in four.
There's a rod that lands two every single time. Costs what you'd expect.
The YOLO. One cast in ten it comes up with a hundred fish on it. The other nine it's a stick.
A telescoping rod pulls the rare ones up where you can reach them.
Quick sell if you must. The market ashore pays every coin, and the only thing it costs you is the sail home.
Finish every fish in a stretch of water and there's a purse waiting for it. Once only.
Prestige a stretch and everything you land there earns better. Five times over, if you've the patience.
Prestige the same water again and the completion purse grows with it.
Idle crew will trawl a zone for you while you're elsewhere. They come back with coin and knowledge both.
On a trawl it's Savvy that brings back the learning and Fortune that brings back the coin. Pick to suit.
You can have a trawl running in every water you've opened. All of them at once, all of them while you sleep.
Crates come up wooden, metal, gold and diamond. Something older comes up in the Ancient Deep.
The Ancient Deep's giants never see the inside of a hold. Straight to the wall.
Every fish you land gets measured. Your biggest of each is kept whether you ask or not.
Trivia in the Parlor of an evening pays in coin. Easiest gold on the island.
Solve the chart room's puzzles and the world chart opens a piece at a time. Gems under every landmark.
The Den takes chips at three tables and they all draw on the one purse.
Three catfish on the slot and the whole jackpot's yours. I've seen it happen. Once.
Past a hundred, everything you learn turns into Renown, and Renown buys things that stay bought.
Raid gear can be fused into better raid gear. There's a forge for it.
Daily challenges reset with the sun. Keep up with them and they add up to real money.
Watch for a lad called Finn. He'll want to make it a contest.
A bigger hold is more time on the water. That's the entire argument for it.
stories: There were six of them, they say. Big as ships and older than ships. Five accounted for.
My father worked the Deep forty years and never went past it. Said the water changes temper out there.
Ask about the Sunken Hand in a tavern and watch who leaves.
Someone's been buying up charts. All of them. Paying stupid money and asking no questions.
The carvings on those stones aren't writing. I've shown them to people who'd know.
A man I knew went out past the Abyss on a bet. Came back. Wouldn't fish again.
You'll hear it said the deep ones are dead. Landed isn't dead.
Whatever counts to six down there, don't answer it.
runnerLines: I have got one rod and no price on it. I have got a stake, and I have got a deck.
Shops ashore won't touch what I carry. That's rather the point of me.
Nine captains out of ten row home lighter. I tell them all that and they all sit down anyway.
You came this far out into the black for a rod that gambles. Do not act surprised.
No paperwork, no chandler, no questions. Put your money on the table.

storm.label: Storm
storm.desc: The board jumps with the swell. Could break either way.

kraken.label: Kraken
kraken.desc: Something big is under the hull. Sell brave or sell nothing.

tide_rising.label: Tide Rising
tide_rising.desc: The tide lifts every price with it. Holding pays.

bounty_season.label: Bounty Season
bounty_season.desc: Buyers flush with coin. Rare fish are climbing fast.

low_tide.label: Low Tide
low_tide.desc: Buyers are tight-fisted today. Hold if you can stomach it.

cursed_waters.label: Cursed Waters
cursed_waters.desc: Bad water. Every price is sinking and picking up speed.

boons.name: Broadside Mastery
boons.flavor: Your gunners find their rhythm. Everything you fire bites harder.

tiers.desc: +10% all damage
tiers.detail: Every shot deals 10% more damage — both the single-shot Fire action and the Volley. It covers every shot you take, where the focused boons only buff one action for a bigger number.

tiers.desc: +22% all damage
tiers.detail: Every shot deals 22% more damage — both the single-shot Fire action and the Volley.

tiers.desc: +36% all damage
tiers.detail: Every shot deals 36% more damage — both the single-shot Fire action and the Volley.

boons.name: Powder & Shot
boons.flavor: Dry powder, packed tight. Your single shots punch through.

tiers.desc: +14% Fire damage
tiers.detail: The single-shot Fire action deals 14% more damage. Your Volley (the 3-charge double shot) is unaffected.

tiers.desc: +30% Fire damage
tiers.detail: The single-shot Fire action deals 30% more damage. Your Volley (the 3-charge double shot) is unaffected.

tiers.desc: +48% Fire damage
tiers.detail: The single-shot Fire action deals 48% more damage. Your Volley (the 3-charge double shot) is unaffected.

boons.name: Grapeshot
boons.flavor: A scatter of iron off the rails. Your volleys shred.

tiers.desc: +14% Volley damage
tiers.detail: Your Volley (the 3-charge double shot) deals 14% more damage. Single Fire shots are unaffected.

tiers.desc: +30% Volley damage
tiers.detail: Your Volley (the 3-charge double shot) deals 30% more damage. Single Fire shots are unaffected.

tiers.desc: +48% Volley damage
tiers.detail: Your Volley (the 3-charge double shot) deals 48% more damage. Single Fire shots are unaffected.

boons.name: Dead-Eye
boons.flavor: You learn exactly where a hull wants to break.

tiers.desc: 8% chance a normal hit becomes a crit
tiers.detail: When you land a normal hit (the green zone on your aim bar), there’s an 8% chance it upgrades into a critical hit anyway — so you can crit even when you miss the gold band. Grazes don’t count.

tiers.desc: 16% chance a normal hit becomes a crit
tiers.detail: When you land a normal hit (the green zone), there’s a 16% chance it upgrades into a critical hit anyway. Grazes don’t count.

tiers.desc: 26% chance a normal hit becomes a crit
tiers.detail: When you land a normal hit (the green zone), there’s a 26% chance it upgrades into a critical hit anyway. Grazes don’t count.

boons.name: Wide Sights
boons.flavor: The perfect shot stops being luck.

tiers.desc: Gold crit band 12% wider
tiers.detail: The gold "perfect shot" band on your aim bar is 12% wider, so landing a critical hit is easier.

tiers.desc: Gold crit band 26% wider
tiers.detail: The gold "perfect shot" band on your aim bar is 26% wider.

tiers.desc: Gold crit band 42% wider
tiers.detail: The gold "perfect shot" band on your aim bar is 42% wider.

boons.name: Ironhide
boons.flavor: Plates doubled along the waterline.

tiers.desc: Take 12% less damage
tiers.detail: Every hit an enemy lands on you deals 12% less damage for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: Take 22% less damage
tiers.detail: Every hit an enemy lands on you deals 22% less damage for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: Take 34% less damage
tiers.detail: Every hit an enemy lands on you deals 34% less damage for the rest of the run.

boons.name: Press the Powder
boons.flavor: Your crew loads like the deep is at their heels.

tiers.desc: 10% chance a Reload loads 2 cannonballs
tiers.detail: Each time you Reload, there’s a 10% chance a second cannonball is loaded for free on top of the usual one.

tiers.desc: 22% chance a Reload loads 2 cannonballs
tiers.detail: Each time you Reload, there’s a 22% chance a second cannonball is loaded for free.

tiers.desc: 36% chance a Reload loads 2 cannonballs
tiers.detail: Each time you Reload, there’s a 36% chance a second cannonball is loaded for free.

boons.name: Following Sea
boons.flavor: The current finally runs with you.

tiers.desc: +2 Initiative
tiers.detail: +2 Initiative: you fire first more often and slip away faster when you flee. (Dodging and landing shots on a dodging enemy are both Evasion — your Navigation — not this.)

tiers.desc: +4 Initiative
tiers.detail: +4 Initiative: you fire first more often and slip away faster when you flee. (Dodging and landing shots on a dodging enemy are both Evasion — your Navigation — not this.)

tiers.desc: +7 Initiative
tiers.detail: +7 Initiative: you fire first far more often and slip away far faster when you flee. (Dodging and landing shots on a dodging enemy are both Evasion — your Navigation — not this.)

boons.name: Bilge Pump
boons.flavor: Patch the seams in the lull before the next gun.

tiers.desc: Heal 5% max HP each fight
tiers.detail: At the start of every fight, your ship repairs 5% of its maximum HP. Scales with your hull, so it keeps mattering as you go deeper.

tiers.desc: Heal 9% max HP each fight
tiers.detail: At the start of every fight, your ship repairs 9% of its maximum HP.

tiers.desc: Heal 14% max HP each fight
tiers.detail: At the start of every fight, your ship repairs 14% of its maximum HP.

boons.name: Ghostward
boons.flavor: Salt and cold iron at the rails. The drowned aim wide.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit 12% less
tiers.detail: Enemies are 12% less likely to land a critical hit on you.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit 24% less
tiers.detail: Enemies are 24% less likely to land a critical hit on you.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit 40% less
tiers.detail: Enemies are 40% less likely to land a critical hit on you.

boons.name: Cold Fury
boons.flavor: When the shot lands true, it lands like the deep itself.

tiers.desc: +17% critical damage
tiers.detail: Your critical hits deal 17% more damage. Stacks with Wide Sights / Dead-Eye landing more crits in the first place.

tiers.desc: +35% critical damage
tiers.detail: Your critical hits deal 35% more damage.

tiers.desc: +52% critical damage
tiers.detail: Your critical hits deal 52% more damage.

boons.name: Giant-Killer
boons.flavor: The bigger the hull, the more of it to hit.

tiers.desc: +17% boss damage
tiers.detail: Deal 17% more damage to boss-depth ships. Regular enemies are unaffected.

tiers.desc: +33% boss damage
tiers.detail: Deal 33% more damage to boss-depth ships. Regular enemies are unaffected.

tiers.desc: +48% boss damage
tiers.detail: Deal 48% more damage to boss-depth ships. Regular enemies are unaffected.

boons.name: Spiteful Wake
boons.flavor: Strike the hull and the hull strikes back — and slip its shot and the sea flings your spite anyway.

tiers.desc: Enemies take back 18% of the hit they aim at you (12% if you dodge)
tiers.detail: Whenever an enemy fires on you, it takes 18% of that shot's full damage right back — even if your armor or a shield soaks the blow. When you DODGE, the enemy still takes 12% of the damage it would have dealt. You punish them whether the hit lands or not.

tiers.desc: Enemies take back 30% of the hit they aim at you (15% if you dodge)
tiers.detail: Enemies take back 30% of every shot's full damage (soaked or not), and 15% of any shot you dodge.

tiers.desc: Enemies take back 42% of the hit they aim at you (18% if you dodge)
tiers.detail: Enemies take back 42% of every shot's full damage (soaked or not), and 18% of any shot you dodge.

boons.name: Wounded Fury
boons.flavor: The closer to sinking, the harder your guns bite.

tiers.desc: Up to +17% damage as HP drops
tiers.detail: Your shots hit harder the lower your HP, scaling with missing health. At full HP nothing; right at the brink, +17%.

tiers.desc: Up to +35% damage as HP drops
tiers.detail: Your shots hit harder the lower your HP, scaling with missing health. At full HP nothing; right at the brink, +35%.

tiers.desc: Up to +52% damage as HP drops
tiers.detail: Your shots hit harder the lower your HP, scaling with missing health. At full HP nothing; right at the brink, +52%.

boons.name: Rising Tide
boons.flavor: Every hull you send down feeds the swell behind you.

tiers.desc: +3% damage per enemy sunk (max +24%)
tiers.detail: Every enemy you sink this run permanently raises your damage by 3%, up to +24%. Counts every hull you have already sunk, and bosses count too. It never resets — the deeper you fight, the harder you hit.

tiers.desc: +4% damage per enemy sunk (max +36%)
tiers.detail: Every enemy you sink this run permanently raises your damage by 4%, up to +36%. Counts hulls already sunk and bosses. Never resets.

tiers.desc: +5% damage per enemy sunk (max +45%)
tiers.detail: Every enemy you sink this run permanently raises your damage by 5%, up to +45%. Counts hulls already sunk and bosses. Never resets.

boons.name: Abyssal Bounty
boons.flavor: The pressure of the deep loads every gun.

tiers.desc: +1.2% damage per depth (max +18%)
tiers.detail: Your damage rises with how deep you are — 1.2% for every depth you have reached, up to +18%. It scales live as you descend, and is full value the moment you take it.

tiers.desc: +1.8% damage per depth (max +28%)
tiers.detail: Your damage rises with how deep you are — 1.8% for every depth reached, up to +28%. Scales live as you descend.

tiers.desc: +2.4% damage per depth (max +38%)
tiers.detail: Your damage rises with how deep you are — 2.4% for every depth reached, up to +38%. Scales live as you descend.

boons.name: Cannonade
boons.flavor: Land them clean and the guns never cool.

tiers.desc: +6% damage per crit in a row (up to +30%)
tiers.detail: Every critical hit you land in a row adds +6% damage, stacking up to +30%. Landing any shot that is NOT a crit resets the streak to zero, and the streak starts fresh each fight.

tiers.desc: +8% damage per crit in a row (up to +40%)
tiers.detail: Every critical hit in a row adds +8% damage, stacking up to +40%. Any non-crit shot resets the streak; it starts fresh each fight.

tiers.desc: +10% damage per crit in a row (up to +60%)
tiers.detail: Every critical hit in a row adds +10% damage, stacking up to +60%. Any non-crit shot resets the streak; it starts fresh each fight.

boons.name: Counter-Battery
boons.flavor: Answer their broadside with yours — and let the sea swallow theirs.

tiers.desc: 20% to cancel the enemy’s shot when you both fire
tiers.detail: When you Fire, Volley or Mega on the same turn the enemy fires or volleys AND your shot lands, you have a 20% chance to smash their shot out of the air — their attack is fully negated while yours still hits. A whiffed aim does not count.

tiers.desc: 32% to cancel the enemy’s shot when you both fire
tiers.detail: When you Fire, Volley or Mega on the same turn the enemy fires or volleys and your shot lands, you have a 32% chance to negate their attack while yours still hits.

tiers.desc: 45% to cancel the enemy’s shot when you both fire
tiers.detail: When you Fire, Volley or Mega on the same turn the enemy fires or volleys and your shot lands, you have a 45% chance to negate their attack while yours still hits.

boons.name: Permafrost
boons.flavor: The cold off your guns finds the seams in their hull and holds it fast.

tiers.desc: 10% chance to freeze; frozen ships take +20% damage
tiers.detail: Each hit you land has a 10% chance to FREEZE the enemy — it loses its next turn — and you deal 20% more damage to a frozen ship. (Stacks with the Frozen Cannonball item, up to 20% total freeze chance.)

tiers.desc: 15% chance to freeze; frozen ships take +32% damage
tiers.detail: Freeze chance rises to 15% and frozen ships take 32% more damage. NEW — Brittle: a critical hit on a frozen ship shatters the ice for DOUBLE the frozen bonus.

tiers.desc: 20% chance to freeze for 2 turns; frozen ships take +42% damage
tiers.detail: Freeze chance rises to 20%, frozen ships take 42% more, and Brittle stays. NEW — Deep Freeze: your freezes now last TWO skipped turns instead of one.

boons.name: Wildfire
boons.flavor: You set the sea alight and let it do the work the guns started.

tiers.desc: 10% chance to set enemies on fire
tiers.detail: Each hit you land has a 10% chance to set the enemy ON FIRE — it takes damage at the start of each of its turns for 3 turns (each tick deals 13% of the hit that started the fire). Stacks with the Incendiary Cannonball item, up to 20% total burn chance.

tiers.desc: 15% chance to burn; hitting a burning ship rekindles it
tiers.detail: Burn chance rises to 15% and the fire ticks harder (16% of the hit). NEW — Reignite: hitting an already-burning ship resets the fire to full duration, so you can keep it burning as long as you keep landing shots.

tiers.desc: 20% chance to burn for 4 turns; fires can flare for bonus bursts
tiers.detail: Burn chance rises to 20%, fires last 4 turns, ticks hit their ceiling (20% of the hit), and Reignite stays. NEW — Backdraft: each burn tick has a chance to flare up for a bonus burst of damage — the longer the fire cooks, the more it erupts.

boons.name: Deep Hull
boons.flavor: The pressure of the deep packs your timbers tighter the further you fall.

tiers.desc: +0.8% max HP per depth (max +14%)
tiers.detail: Your maximum HP grows with how deep you are — 0.8% for every depth reached, up to +14%. It scales live as you descend, and each increase is healed to you.

tiers.desc: +1.6% max HP per depth (max +30%)
tiers.detail: Your maximum HP grows 1.6% for every depth reached, up to +30%. Scales live as you descend; each increase heals you by that much.

tiers.desc: +2.4% max HP per depth (max +48%)
tiers.detail: Your maximum HP grows 2.4% for every depth reached, up to +48%. Scales live as you descend; each increase heals you by that much.

boons.name: Salvage Hull
boons.flavor: Every wreck you leave, your crew strips for plating.

tiers.desc: +0.6% max HP per hull sunk (max +12%)
tiers.detail: Every enemy you sink this run permanently raises your maximum HP by 0.6%, up to +12%. Bosses count, it never resets, and each gain is healed to you.

tiers.desc: +1.2% max HP per hull sunk (max +26%)
tiers.detail: Every hull sunk raises your maximum HP by 1.2%, up to +26%. Never resets; each gain heals you by that much.

tiers.desc: +1.8% max HP per hull sunk (max +42%)
tiers.detail: Every hull sunk raises your maximum HP by 1.8%, up to +42%. Never resets; each gain heals you by that much.

boons.name: Reinforced Hull
boons.flavor: Double plate along the keel. More ship to sink.

tiers.desc: +8% max HP
tiers.detail: Your maximum HP is 8% higher for the rest of the run. It also makes every heal and shield that scales off your max HP bigger.

tiers.desc: +20% max HP
tiers.detail: Your maximum HP is 20% higher for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: +36% max HP
tiers.detail: Your maximum HP is 36% higher for the rest of the run.

boons.name: Executioner
boons.flavor: Below a certain mark, a hull is already gone — it just doesn't know it yet.

tiers.desc: Sink enemies below 5% HP
tiers.detail: The instant any hit drops an enemy to 5% of its health or lower, it is sunk outright — no need to chip out the last sliver.

tiers.desc: Sink enemies below 8% HP
tiers.detail: The instant any hit drops an enemy to 8% of its health or lower, it is sunk outright.

boons.name: Leviathan's Hunger
boons.flavor: Every wound you open, the deep drinks — and feeds it back to your hull.

tiers.desc: Heal 10% of the damage you deal, up to 20% of your hull a hit
tiers.detail: Whenever you damage an enemy, your ship heals for 10% of that damage — the harder you hit, the more you heal. One hit can return at most 20% of your maximum HP, which is always twice your lifesteal. Other lifesteal, like Davy’s Blood Cannon, adds to your percentage and lifts that cap with it.

tiers.desc: Heal 20% of the damage you deal, up to 40% of your hull a hit
tiers.detail: Whenever you damage an enemy, your ship heals for 20% of that damage. One hit can return at most 40% of your maximum HP, which is always twice your lifesteal. Other lifesteal, like Davy’s Blood Cannon, adds to your percentage and lifts that cap with it.

boons.name: Powder Hoard
boons.flavor: Whatever your crew doesn't spend, they keep racked for the next hull.

tiers.desc: Carry up to 2 cannonballs to the next fight
tiers.detail: Cannonballs you leave unfired when a fight ends carry into the next one, up to 2 of them.

tiers.desc: Carry every unfired cannonball to the next fight
tiers.detail: Every cannonball you leave unfired when a fight ends carries into the next one, up to your full magazine.

boons.name: Stormward
boons.flavor: A ward of cold iron reforms before every gun. It eats the first blows so your hull never feels them.

tiers.desc: Shield 10% of max HP each fight
tiers.detail: Start every fight with a shield worth 10% of your max HP. It soaks incoming damage before your hull takes any, and reforms fresh each fight.

tiers.desc: Shield 18% of max HP each fight
tiers.detail: Start every fight with a shield worth 18% of your max HP. It soaks incoming damage before your hull takes any, and reforms fresh each fight.

boons.name: Rattling Shot
boons.flavor: Your iron rattles a hull loose, and it flinches at every blow after.

tiers.desc: 35% on a hit to make the enemy Feeble (+15% damage taken, 2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 35% chance the enemy turns Feeble — it takes 15% more damage from everything for the next 2 rounds. Reapplying refreshes it rather than stacking.

tiers.desc: 45% on a hit to make the enemy Feeble (+20% damage taken, 2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 45% chance the enemy turns Feeble — it takes 20% more damage from everything for the next 2 rounds.

tiers.desc: 55% on a hit to make the enemy Feeble (+25% damage taken, 3 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 55% chance the enemy turns Feeble — it takes 25% more damage from everything for the next 3 rounds.

boons.name: Chainshot
boons.flavor: Linked iron fouls their rigging. A snarled hull is a slow hull.

tiers.desc: 30% on a hit to Slow the enemy (2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 30% chance the enemy is Slowed for 2 rounds — it acts later in the round, ceding you the opening more often.

tiers.desc: 45% on a hit to Slow the enemy (2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 45% chance the enemy is Slowed for 2 rounds — it acts later in the round, ceding you the opening more often.

tiers.desc: 60% on a hit to heavily Slow the enemy (3 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 60% chance the enemy is heavily Slowed for 3 rounds — it acts later in the round, ceding you the opening far more often.

boons.name: Hexshot
boons.flavor: A cursed round saps the fight out of whatever it strikes.

tiers.desc: 30% on a hit to Weaken the enemy (−15% damage dealt, 2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 30% chance the enemy is Weakened — its own hits deal 15% less damage for the next 2 rounds.

tiers.desc: 45% on a hit to Weaken the enemy (−22% damage dealt, 2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 45% chance the enemy is Weakened — its own hits deal 22% less damage for the next 2 rounds.

tiers.desc: 60% on a hit to Weaken the enemy (−30% damage dealt, 3 rounds)
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there is a 60% chance the enemy is Weakened — its own hits deal 30% less damage for the next 3 rounds.

boons.name: Armor-Piercing Shot
boons.flavor: Ghost-iron finds the gap in any ward. Barriers are a suggestion.

tiers.desc: Your shots ignore 35% of enemy barriers
tiers.detail: A slice of every shot you fire skips straight past an enemy barrier and hits the hull — 35% of the damage ignores the shield entirely. The hard counter to the Warding curse and the ghost fleet’s shielded hulls.

tiers.desc: Your shots ignore 55% of enemy barriers
tiers.detail: 55% of every shot skips the barrier and hits the hull directly.

tiers.desc: Your shots ignore 75% of enemy barriers
tiers.detail: 75% of every shot skips the barrier and hits the hull directly — barriers barely slow you.

boons.name: Press-Gang
boons.flavor: What’s theirs is yours. Rip the shot right off their deck and load it yourself.

tiers.desc: 20% on a hit to steal an enemy cannonball
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there’s a 20% chance you rip a loaded cannonball off the enemy and ram it into your own rack — you gain the shot, they lose it. Does nothing if your rack is already full or the enemy is empty.

tiers.desc: 30% on a hit to steal an enemy cannonball
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there’s a 30% chance you steal a loaded cannonball off the enemy into your own rack.

tiers.desc: 40% on a hit to steal an enemy cannonball
tiers.detail: Whenever you land a hit, there’s a 40% chance you steal a loaded cannonball off the enemy into your own rack.

boons.name: Loaded for Bear
boons.flavor: Every so often your gunners pack a shot that simply cannot miss the mark.

tiers.desc: Every 5th landed shot is a guaranteed crit
tiers.detail: Count your landed shots each fight — every 5th one is upgraded to a guaranteed critical hit. (A shot that whiffs on the count just doesn’t upgrade.)

tiers.desc: Every 4th landed shot is a guaranteed crit
tiers.detail: Every 4th landed shot each fight is upgraded to a guaranteed critical hit.

tiers.desc: Every 3rd landed shot is a guaranteed crit
tiers.detail: Every 3rd landed shot each fight is upgraded to a guaranteed critical hit.

boons.name: Kraken's Grip
boons.flavor: A landed shot calls the deep up around their hull — and the deep does not let go.

tiers.desc: Each hit coils tighter and can seize; the 5th always does. Held a turn, crushed 2% of its max HP per coil
tiers.detail: Every hit you land coils the deep tighter around the hull, and every coil raises the chance it closes — slim at the first, certain at the fifth. When it closes, the ship loses its next turn and is crushed for 2% of its OWN maximum HP per coil that had built up, so a late close hits far harder than an early one. Because the odds and the crush both ride the same count, luck decides the rhythm and never the damage. The coils are around that hull, so a fresh enemy starts the count again. Bosses are not immune, and since the crush is a share of their own hull, the biggest ships take the most.

tiers.desc: Coils close by the 4th hit, hold 2 turns, and crush 3% of its max HP per coil
tiers.detail: The deep closes sooner and holds longer: the count runs to four instead of five, the hull loses its next TWO turns, and the crush rises to 3% of its own maximum HP per coil that had built up. Every coil still raises the chance it closes early, and the crush still pays for the coils spent, so the roll only ever moves the rhythm.

boons.name: Cutlass Guard
boons.flavor: Meet the blow, turn it, and answer before they’ve recovered.

tiers.desc: 20% to parry a hit (take nothing) and lash back 40%
tiers.detail: Every enemy blow that would land has a 20% chance to be PARRIED — you take no damage, and 40% of the hit it aimed at you is flung straight back. A parry counts as an avoided hit.

tiers.desc: 30% to parry a hit and lash back 55%
tiers.detail: Enemy blows have a 30% chance to be parried; you take nothing and reflect 55% of the intended hit.

tiers.desc: 40% to parry a hit and lash back 70%
tiers.detail: Enemy blows have a 40% chance to be parried; you take nothing and reflect 70% of the intended hit.

boons.name: Steady Sights
boons.flavor: The green can fog every glass in the fleet but yours.

tiers.desc: Aim fog + blackout cut in half
tiers.detail: Any fog, mist, or blackout thrown over your aim bar (enemy Mist Veil, the ghost fleet, fog curses) is cut by 50% — your sight stays clearer than the fleet’s.

tiers.desc: Aim fog + blackout cut 75%
tiers.detail: Aim fog, mist, and blackout are reduced by 75%.

tiers.desc: Immune to aim fog, blackout AND decoys
tiers.detail: Nothing clouds your glass: aim fog, mist, and blackout are gone entirely, and false-target decoys never drift your bar.

boons.name: The Don's Favor
boons.flavor: The Don owes no one, but now and then the green smiles on you anyway. Never the same way twice.

tiers.desc: Open each fight with a random blessing (Enrage / Fortify / Mending)
tiers.detail: At the start of EVERY fight you roll one of three blessings for the whole fight: ENRAGED (+25% damage dealt), FORTIFIED (−25% damage taken), or MENDING (heal a slice of your hull each round). Which one is always a surprise.

tiers.desc: A STRONGER random blessing each fight
tiers.detail: Every fight opens with a stronger random blessing: ENRAGED (+40% damage), FORTIFIED (−40% damage taken), or MENDING (a bigger heal each round).

boons.name: Second Calling
boons.flavor: Some crews the deep just won’t let rest. Call them once, and the green calls them right back.

tiers.desc: 15% chance a crew ability isn’t spent when used
tiers.detail: When you fire a crew ability, there’s a 15% chance it ISN’T spent — the effect still happens, but the crew keeps their station and the ability is ready again next turn (one ability per turn still holds).

tiers.desc: 25% chance a crew ability isn’t spent when used
tiers.detail: When you fire a crew ability, there’s a 25% chance it isn’t spent and stays ready for next turn.

tiers.desc: 35% chance a crew ability isn’t spent when used
tiers.detail: When you fire a crew ability, there’s a 35% chance it isn’t spent and stays ready for next turn.

boons.name: Blood in the Water
boons.flavor: The deep hates a wasted kill. Strike harder than the hull can take, and it hands you back the difference.

tiers.desc: Heal 20% of overkill damage on a kill, up to 40% of your hull
tiers.detail: When a shot sinks a hull, any damage that lands PAST its remaining HP is overkill (normally wasted). You heal 20% of that overkill back to your ship. A clean shot that drops it exactly to zero heals nothing — the reward is for hitting hard enough to spill over. One kill can return at most 40% of your maximum HP, which is always twice your overkill share, so a huge Mega cannot refill the whole bar at once.

tiers.desc: Heal 35% of overkill damage on a kill, up to 70% of your hull
tiers.detail: A kill spills over harder: you heal 35% of any overkill damage (the amount a killing blow lands past the hull’s remaining HP) back to your ship. One kill can return at most 70% of your maximum HP.

tiers.desc: Heal 50% of overkill damage on a kill, up to 70% of your hull
tiers.detail: Half of every killing blow’s overkill comes back as hull. Land a massive shot on a wounded enemy and you top yourself off on the way through. One kill can return at most 70% of your maximum HP, so one shot can never full-heal you.

boons.name: Man-o-War's Wrath
boons.flavor: The big gun was already the last word. Now it argues.

tiers.desc: +22% Mega damage
tiers.detail: Your Mega — the Man-o-War ultimate that spends a full 4-charge magazine — hits 22% harder. Affects the Mega ONLY: your Fire and Volley are unchanged. This does nothing unless your ship carries a Mega augment (the Man-o-War ultimate weapon), so only take it if you can fire one.

tiers.desc: +38% Mega damage
tiers.detail: Your Mega ultimate hits 38% harder. Mega only — Fire and Volley unaffected. Requires a Mega augment to do anything.

tiers.desc: +58% Mega damage
tiers.detail: Your Mega ultimate hits 58% harder — the single biggest shot in your arsenal, turned up. Mega only. Requires a Mega augment to do anything.

curses.name: Crushing Depth
curses.flavor: The water itself leans on your hull. Every fight begins a little closer to the breaking point.

tiers.desc: Lose 8% max HP before every fight
tiers.detail: At the start of every fight from now on, your ship loses 8% of its maximum HP. It can never land the killing blow itself (you stop at 1 HP), but it steadily wears you down.

tiers.desc: Lose 13% max HP before every fight
tiers.detail: The pressure deepens. Your ship now sheds 13% of its maximum HP at the start of every fight (still never below 1).

curses.name: Bloodthirst
curses.flavor: The drowned smell your wake. Every gun down here is aimed to kill, not to warn.

tiers.desc: Enemies deal 20% more damage
tiers.detail: Every hit an enemy lands on you deals 20% more damage for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: Enemies deal 30% more damage
tiers.detail: The frenzy spreads. Every enemy hit now lands for 30% more damage.

curses.name: The Warding
curses.flavor: A cold light sheathes every hull down here. You have to break the barrier before you can break the ship.

tiers.desc: Enemies carry a 20% barrier
tiers.detail: Every enemy starts each fight behind a barrier worth 20% of its hull. Your shots chew through the barrier before its health takes a scratch (burn bleeds through, and the Railgun pierces it). It reforms fresh each fight.

tiers.desc: Enemies carry a 32% barrier
tiers.detail: The warding thickens. Every enemy now hides behind a barrier worth 32% of its hull each fight.

curses.name: Becalmed
curses.flavor: The wind died at this depth. Your ship answers the wheel a beat too slow.

tiers.desc: -3 Initiative
tiers.detail: Your ship is 3 slower off the mark. Initiative decides who fires first, so you will act after the enemy more often and be harder-pressed to flee. (Your dodge and aim ride on Evasion, so they hold steady.)

tiers.desc: -5 Initiative
tiers.detail: The calm thickens. Your ship is 5 slower now, ceding the first shot far more often.

curses.name: Murk
curses.flavor: The dark closes over your sights. The perfect shot is a narrower thing now.

tiers.desc: Your crit zone is 15% smaller
tiers.detail: The gold "perfect shot" band on your aim bar shrinks by 15%, so landing a critical hit is harder.

tiers.desc: Your crit zone is 32% smaller
tiers.detail: The dark all but closes the window. The gold "perfect shot" band shrinks by 32%.

curses.name: Sounding Fog
curses.flavor: The water goes blind at this depth. You fire at shapes in the murk.

tiers.desc: Fog rolls over your aim bar
tiers.detail: A bank of fog drifts back and forth across your aim bar, hiding the gold crit band as it passes. Lock your shots by rhythm, not by sight.

tiers.desc: Thick fog smothers your aim bar
tiers.detail: The fog rolls in heavy, hiding the gold band for longer and leaving only narrow slivers of clear sight.

curses.name: Shrouded Hull
curses.flavor: The enemy hull swims in and out of the murk. You never quite know how close it is to going under.

tiers.desc: 25% chance the enemy’s health is hidden
tiers.detail: Each fight, a 25% chance the enemy’s HP bar is fogged over. You fight blind on how close it is to sinking, judging by the numbers you land instead.

tiers.desc: 50% chance the enemy’s health is hidden
tiers.detail: The murk thickens: a 50% chance each fight that the enemy’s HP is hidden entirely.

curses.name: Shuttered Ports
curses.flavor: Their gun ports stay shut till the muzzles run out. No counting the shots they hold.

tiers.desc: 25% chance the enemy’s loaded shots are hidden
tiers.detail: Each fight, a 25% chance you can’t see the enemy’s cannonball count. No telling when the next broadside comes.

tiers.desc: 50% chance the enemy’s loaded shots are hidden
tiers.detail: A 50% chance each fight the enemy’s loaded shots are hidden from you entirely.

curses.name: Racing Tide
curses.flavor: A fast current rips down the deck. The wheel will not hold still.

tiers.desc: Your aim needle sweeps faster
tiers.detail: Your aiming needle whips back and forth quicker for the rest of the run, so the window to lock a clean shot is tighter.

tiers.desc: Your aim needle races across the bar
tiers.detail: The current rips harder. Your needle tears back and forth, and a clean lock takes real timing.

curses.name: Roiling Sea
curses.flavor: The sea heaves under you. Nothing you aim at stays where you left it.

tiers.desc: The target band lurches
tiers.detail: The gold target band slides across your aim bar much faster and wilder, so where the perfect shot sits is a moving guess every turn.

tiers.desc: The target band thrashes
tiers.detail: The sea goes violent. The gold band careens across the bar, almost never where it was a beat ago.

curses.name: Inkfall
curses.flavor: Something vast empties its ink into the water, and the world goes black in lurches.

tiers.desc: Your aim bar blacks out in fits
tiers.detail: A dark veil falls over your aim bar in short, random fits, swallowing the needle and the gold band for a beat at a time. Lock by rhythm when the dark takes it.

tiers.desc: Your aim bar drowns in dark
tiers.detail: The ink comes harder and blacker, blotting out the whole aim bar in fits. You will fire half-blind.

curses.name: Waterlogged Powder
curses.flavor: Seawater finds the magazine. Your guns cough where they used to roar.

tiers.desc: Your shots deal 15% less damage
tiers.detail: Damp powder and weak charges. Every shot you fire deals 15% less damage for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: Your shots deal 28% less damage
tiers.detail: The whole magazine is soaked through. Every shot you fire now deals 28% less damage.

curses.name: All or Nothing
curses.flavor: The deep has no patience for a near miss. Land it true or do not bother.

tiers.desc: Non-crit shots deal 18% less
tiers.detail: Anything short of a gold critical hits soft. Your hit and graze shots deal 18% less damage; only perfect crits land at full force.

tiers.desc: Non-crit shots deal 32% less
tiers.detail: The margin for error vanishes. Non-crit shots now deal 32% less damage; only a gold crit truly bites.

curses.name: Leaden Hands
curses.flavor: Numb fingers, slow heave. The wheel comes around a moment too late.

tiers.desc: Your dodges fail more often
tiers.detail: The cold sinks into the crew. Your ship is 15% less likely to weave aside from an enemy shot for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: Your dodges fail far more often
tiers.detail: The crew goes leaden to the bone. Your ship is 28% less likely to weave aside from an enemy shot.

curses.name: Sharpshooters
curses.flavor: They have done this longer than you have been alive, and they know exactly where to aim.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit you 10% more often
tiers.detail: The drowned gunners find the gaps in your hull. Every enemy is 10% more likely to land a critical hit on you for the rest of the run.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit you 20% more often
tiers.detail: They have your range cold. Every enemy is 20% more likely to land a critical hit on you.

curses.name: Barnacled Hull
curses.flavor: Crusted iron and dead coral. These ships have been sinking for a hundred years and still will not go under.

tiers.desc: Enemies are 15% tougher
tiers.detail: The deep grows thick over every hull down here. Enemies have 15% more HP for the rest of the run, so every fight drags on longer.

tiers.desc: Enemies are 25% tougher
tiers.detail: The crust grows inches thick. Enemies have 25% more HP for the rest of the run.

curses.name: Loaded Guns
curses.flavor: No warning shot, no parley. The drowned were aiming before you ever drew alongside.

tiers.desc: Enemies open every fight already loaded
tiers.detail: Every enemy from now on starts each fight with a cannonball already chambered, so the ones that lead with their guns can fire on you from the opening bell.

tiers.desc: Enemies open every fight loaded for a volley
tiers.detail: Every enemy now starts each fight with two cannonballs chambered, ready to open with their heaviest shot.

curses.name: False Colors
curses.flavor: The drowned fly colors that are not their own. Half the targets out there are lies.

tiers.desc: A false target sometimes drifts your aim bar
tiers.detail: On some of your shots (not all), a decoy target band drifts across your aim bar alongside the real gold one. Lock onto the decoy and your shot is a dud: you take chip damage and your turn ends without firing. Pick the real band out of the lie.

tiers.desc: Two false targets sometimes drift your aim bar
tiers.detail: The deception thickens. Now two decoy bands can drift your aim bar at once, so threading a clean shot to the real target gets harder. Locking either decoy still duds your shot and ends your turn.

curses.name: Drowned Whispers
curses.flavor: Voices well up from the deep with orders that are not yours, and a rattled crew obeys the wrong one.

tiers.desc: 12% of your orders come out scrambled
tiers.detail: Each turn, a 12% chance the action you choose comes out as a DIFFERENT one — pick Fire and your crew might dodge, pick Dodge and they might reload, and so on. It only ever swaps to an action you could actually take. (Repair is never scrambled.)

tiers.desc: 20% of your orders come out scrambled
tiers.detail: The whispers grow louder. Now a 20% chance each turn that your chosen action comes out as a different valid one.

curses.name: Dead Hands
curses.flavor: The cold creeps up the rigging and into your crew. The ones it takes never lift a gun again.

tiers.desc: One crew can no longer refresh its ability
tiers.detail: The deep silences one of your crew. Their special ability stops coming back between fights, so once it's spent it stays spent for the rest of the run. (If it was already spent, it's gone now.)

tiers.desc: Two crew can no longer refresh their abilities
tiers.detail: The cold spreads. A second crew falls silent too, so two of your special abilities no longer refresh for the rest of the run.

curses.name: The Crush
curses.flavor: Past sixty fathoms there are no tricks left in the dark. There is only the weight.

tiers.desc: Take 8% more damage (1 fathom of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 8% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 17% more damage (2 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 17% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 26% more damage (3 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 26% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 36% more damage (4 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 36% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 47% more damage (5 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 47% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 59% more damage (6 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 59% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 71% more damage (7 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 71% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 85% more damage (8 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 85% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 100% more damage (9 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 100% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 116% more damage (10 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 116% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 133% more damage (11 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 133% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 152% more damage (12 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 152% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 172% more damage (13 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 172% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 194% more damage (14 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 194% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

tiers.desc: Take 217% more damage (15 fathoms of pressure)
tiers.detail: The deep itself leans on your hull, and it never stops leaning. Every enemy hit now lands 217% harder. Every few depths the Crush adds another fathom of pressure on top, and it compounds without end.

curses.name: Narrowed Sights
curses.flavor: The green pinches your glass to a needle’s eye. The perfect shot all but vanishes.

tiers.desc: The gold crit band shrinks 30%
tiers.detail: The gold "perfect shot" band on your aim bar narrows by 30% for the rest of the run — crits are far harder to land because the target is simply smaller. Boons that widen the band still help.

tiers.desc: The gold crit band shrinks 45%
tiers.detail: The band pinches to a sliver — 45% narrower. Landing a critical takes near-perfect timing.

curses.name: The Mark
curses.flavor: The Don paints your hull before the bell. You start every fight already bleeding.

tiers.desc: Start every fight Feeble (+15% damage taken, 2 rounds)
tiers.detail: Every fight from now on opens with your ship already Feeble — you take 15% more damage from every hit for the first 2 rounds of each fight, until it wears off. Cleansing it (a Mender) clears it early.

tiers.desc: Start every fight Feeble (+22% damage taken, 3 rounds)
tiers.detail: The brand cuts deeper: every fight opens with your ship Feeble for 3 rounds, taking 22% more damage from every hit until it wears off.

curses.name: The Verdict
curses.flavor: The Don has already decided how this ends. His guns just carry out the sentence.

tiers.desc: Enemy ultimates hit +25% and charge faster
tiers.detail: Every enemy ultimate lands 25% harder, and their reloads have a good chance to load an extra charge — so the big blow comes sooner, and hurts more.

tiers.desc: Enemy ultimates hit +50% and charge much faster
tiers.detail: Enemy ultimates now land 50% harder and charge much faster.

curses.name: Cutpurse Tide
curses.flavor: The green picks your pockets. Every hull down here reaches for your powder.

tiers.desc: Enemies rip your cannonballs on a +15% chance
tiers.detail: Every enemy — not just the sharks — gains a 15% chance on a landed hit to tear a loaded cannonball clean off your rack. Reload gets it back, but you lose the tempo.

tiers.desc: Enemies rip your cannonballs on a +28% chance
tiers.detail: Every enemy now has a 28% chance on a hit to rip a loaded cannonball off your rack.

curses.name: Thornmail
curses.flavor: The ghost fleet armors in cold iron that turns a shot the way a reef turns a wave.

tiers.desc: Enemies parry 15% of your shots (dealing nothing)
tiers.detail: Every enemy has a 15% chance to PARRY a shot you fire — it turns the blow aside entirely and takes no damage. Your Mega ultimate can never be parried.

tiers.desc: Enemies parry 25% of your shots
tiers.detail: Every enemy now has a 25% chance to parry a shot you fire, taking no damage.

curses.name: The Tithe
curses.flavor: Every wound they open on you, the green feeds straight back into their hull. You pay the tithe in blood.

tiers.desc: Enemies heal 15% of the damage they deal you
tiers.detail: Every hit an enemy lands on you heals it for 15% of that damage (never above its own full hull). A long fight against a Tithed enemy is a war of attrition you are losing.

tiers.desc: Enemies heal 28% of the damage they deal you
tiers.detail: Every enemy hit now heals it for 28% of the damage it deals you.

curses.name: Bloodscent
curses.flavor: The green guides their gunners to your seams. Every hull down here shoots for the kill.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit you 15% more often
tiers.detail: Every enemy in the run gains a flat +15% chance to land a CRITICAL hit on you — the big, painful shots come far more often. Dodging still avoids them entirely.

tiers.desc: Enemies crit you 28% more often
tiers.detail: The scent thickens: enemies land criticals on you 28% more often. Bracing and dodging matter more than ever.

curses.name: Flare Storm
curses.flavor: The green lights the whole sky. When the keeper’s crews throw flares, they come like a squall.

tiers.desc: Flare barrages hit 30% harder and come a bit faster
tiers.detail: On any enemy that throws a Flare Barrage (the swat-the-flares, don’t-tap-the-red test), every flare you let through or feint you tap chips you for 30% more, and the fuses run a little tighter. Enemies with no flares are unaffected.

tiers.desc: Flare barrages hit 55% harder and come faster
tiers.detail: The sky never darkens. Each flare mistake chips you for 55% more, and the fuses run tighter. Only enemies that throw flares are affected — but this deep, plenty do.

curses.name: Barrier Regrowth
curses.flavor: Ghost-iron knits itself shut faster than you can peel it. Hit it all at once, or not at all.

tiers.desc: Enemies carry a 25% barrier that reknits 8% each round
tiers.detail: Every enemy starts each fight behind a barrier worth 25% of its hull, and at the top of every round the barrier reknits 8% of its full value before your shot lands. A slow chip never breaks through — you have to burst it open in one turn (burn bleeds through, the Railgun pierces it).

tiers.desc: Enemies carry a 35% barrier that reknits 14% each round
tiers.detail: The warding is relentless — a 35% barrier that reknits 14% of its full value every round. Only a heavy burst opens the hull beneath.

confluences.name: Thermal Shock
confluences.flavor: Ice in the seams, fire on the deck. The hull cracks where the two meet.
confluences.detail: When an enemy is frozen and on fire at the same time, your next hit shatters the ice — dealing bonus damage on top of the hit (a percentage of that hit). The shatter ends the freeze.

levels.desc: Frozen + burning hulls shatter for +50% bonus damage
Frozen + burning hulls shatter for +70% bonus damage
Frozen + burning hulls shatter for +95% bonus damage

confluences.name: Coup de Grâce
confluences.flavor: You know the killing mark, and when the shot rings true you find it every time.
confluences.detail: Your critical hits deal extra damage, and any critical hit that leaves the enemy at low HP sinks it on the spot — a much wider finishing mark than Executioner alone.

levels.desc: +12% crit damage; a crit sinks hulls below 12% HP
+18% crit damage; a crit sinks hulls below 16% HP
+25% crit damage; a crit sinks hulls below 20% HP

confluences.name: Hull Render
confluences.flavor: Every gun on the rail, again and again, until the seams give. The deep loves a drummer.
confluences.detail: Your Volley (the 3-cannonball heavy shot) hits harder, and every Volley you land in a fight makes the next one hit harder still. The ramp resets when the fight ends.

levels.desc: +12% Volley damage, and each Volley adds +12% more this fight
+18% Volley damage, and each Volley adds +15% more this fight
+25% Volley damage, and each Volley adds +18% more this fight

confluences.name: Reaper's Tithe
confluences.flavor: Every hull you send down, the deep tithes back to you. Death feeds the killer.
confluences.detail: Every enemy you sink heals you for a slice of ITS max HP — bigger ships pay a bigger tithe. The heal is capped at 15% of your own max HP per kill, so deep-run giants can’t refill your whole bar.

levels.desc: Sinking a hull heals you 12% of its max HP (up to 15% of yours)
Sinking a hull heals you 16% of its max HP (up to 15% of yours)
Sinking a hull heals you 22% of its max HP (up to 15% of yours)

confluences.name: Feed the Fire
confluences.flavor: The flames you set drink from the enemy and pour it into your hull.
confluences.detail: While an enemy burns, every burn tick also heals you — a percentage of the damage that tick dealt. Capped at 20% of your max HP per tick. Keep the fire going and the fire keeps you afloat.

levels.desc: Burn damage also heals you 65% of each tick
Burn damage also heals you 95% of each tick
Burn damage also heals you 130% of each tick

confluences.name: Weather Gauge
confluences.flavor: Hold the wind and you hold the fight. You choose the moment, and the first broadside is yours.
confluences.detail: You seize the opening far more often, and when you take the first shot, there is a chance to loose a second broadside before the enemy can answer.

levels.desc: Take the opening +25%; opening shot 20% to strike twice
Take the opening +35%; opening shot 30% to strike twice
Take the opening +50%; opening shot 40% to strike twice

confluences.name: Iron Tempest
confluences.flavor: Plate over plate, and every blow that breaks on it is flung back twofold.
confluences.detail: Multiplies Spiteful Wake: the damage you throw back when an enemy hits you is boosted by this factor. With Ironhide shrinking what you take, you become a wall that bites.

levels.desc: Spiteful Wake’s thrown-back damage hits 1.8× harder
Spiteful Wake’s thrown-back damage hits 2.5× harder
Spiteful Wake’s thrown-back damage hits 3.2× harder

confluences.name: Broadside Duel
confluences.flavor: Trade broadsides and win the exchange every time — their shot in the water, and the guns already coming back to bear.
confluences.detail: Boosts Counter-Battery: your chance to knock an enemy shot out of the air goes up, and every shot you DO knock down feeds Cannonade’s crit streak (and can hand you back a cannonball). Winning the exchange keeps your rhythm even on a non-crit.

levels.desc: +8% counter chance; a counter adds a Cannonade streak stack
+15% counter chance; a counter adds a stack and a free cannonball
+22% counter chance; a counter adds 2 stacks and a free cannonball

confluences.name: Return to Sender
confluences.flavor: Their own shell, caught mid-air and flung right back down their throat.
confluences.detail: When Counter-Battery knocks an enemy shot out of the air, the shell is flung back at them — dealing a percentage of the damage it WOULD have done to you. You take nothing; they eat their own broadside.

levels.desc: A countered shot is flung back for 60% of its damage
A countered shot is flung back for 85% of its damage
A countered shot is flung back for 120% of its damage

confluences.name: Feeding Frenzy
confluences.flavor: The swell of the slain makes the deep drink deeper — every hull in your wake feeds the next wound.
confluences.detail: Every enemy you sink this run makes Leviathan’s Hunger drink deeper — the share of your damage that comes back as healing grows with each kill, up to the cap. It never resets during the run.

levels.desc: Healing from damage grows +1.5% per hull sunk (max +18%), raising your heal cap with it
Healing from damage grows +2% per hull sunk (max +24%), raising your heal cap with it
Healing from damage grows +2.5% per hull sunk (max +30%), raising your heal cap with it

confluences.name: Bullseye
confluences.flavor: Wide sights and a killer’s eye. The gold band stops being luck and starts being a habit.
confluences.detail: Two ways to crit more, stacked: the gold crit band on your aim bar gets wider (easier to land a crit on purpose), AND normal hits get an extra chance to upgrade into crits anyway.

levels.desc: Gold band 10% wider; hits +10% more likely to become crits
Gold band 16% wider; hits +16% more likely to become crits
Gold band 24% wider; hits +24% more likely to become crits

confluences.name: Deep Wake
confluences.flavor: The hulls in your wake and the weight of the deep pull in the same direction — down, and harder.
confluences.detail: Feeds both momentum boons at once: Rising Tide gains more damage per hull you sink, Abyssal Bounty gains more per depth you reach, and both of their caps are raised. Your snowball rolls faster and further.

levels.desc: Rising Tide +1% more per kill, Abyssal Bounty +0.5% more per depth; caps +5%
Rising Tide +1.5% more per kill, Abyssal Bounty +0.6% more per depth; caps +8%
Rising Tide +2% more per kill, Abyssal Bounty +0.8% more per depth; caps +10%

confluences.name: Dreadnought
confluences.flavor: The bigger the hull, the more of it to scatter your iron across. Bring the whole broadside.
confluences.detail: Extra damage against BOSSES only, on top of your boons: everything you fire at a boss hits harder, and your Volleys hit harder still. Regular enemies are unaffected.

levels.desc: Bosses take +12% from everything, +18% more from Volleys
Bosses take +20% from everything, +30% more from Volleys
Bosses take +30% from everything, +45% more from Volleys

confluences.name: Last Bastion
confluences.flavor: A heavier ward, and hands quick on the seams. Nothing gets through that you can’t out-mend.
confluences.detail: You start every fight with a bigger shield (a percentage of your max HP that soaks damage before your hull does) AND heal a little extra at the start of each fight. Both stack on top of Stormward and Bilge Pump.

levels.desc: Start each fight with an extra 20%-of-max-HP shield and a +4% heal
Start each fight with an extra 28%-of-max-HP shield and a +7% heal
Start each fight with an extra 36%-of-max-HP shield and a +10% heal

confluences.name: Powder Keg
confluences.flavor: A crew that never stops loading and never wastes a shell. The magazine is always full and always spilling over.
confluences.detail: Ammo, everywhere: you start every fight with extra cannonballs already loaded, and each Reload has a chance to load bonus cannonball(s) on top of the usual one.

levels.desc: Start fights +1 loaded; Reloads load a bonus cannonball 15% of the time
Start fights +2 loaded; Reloads load a bonus cannonball 25% of the time
Start fights +2 loaded; Reloads load 2 bonus cannonballs 35% of the time

confluences.name: Pressure Hull
confluences.flavor: The same deep that loads your guns crushes down on theirs. The lower you go, the less they land.
confluences.detail: You take less damage the deeper you are — the reduction grows with every depth you reach, up to the cap. Stacks on top of Ironhide, so a deep run gets very hard to hurt.

levels.desc: Take less damage per depth reached (up to -12%)
Take less damage per depth reached (up to -20%)
Take less damage per depth reached (up to -28%)

confluences.name: Field Repairs
confluences.flavor: A bigger hull and a crew who patch it like the deep is at their heels — and the seams hold water above the waterline.
confluences.detail: Your repair kits heal more, and healing can OVERFILL your HP bar — pushing you above max into a temporary buffer that soaks damage. The overfill lasts for the current fight only.

levels.desc: Repair kits heal +30%; heals can overfill you to 115% HP this fight
Repair kits heal +45%; heals can overfill you to 125% HP this fight
Repair kits heal +60%; heals can overfill you to 140% HP this fight

confluences.name: Engorge
confluences.flavor: The deep drinks through every wound you open, and your hull swells past its own lines with the surfeit.
confluences.detail: The healing from Leviathan’s Hunger can OVERFILL your HP bar — damage you deal at full health banks a temporary buffer above max that soaks hits. The overfill lasts for the current fight only.

levels.desc: Healing from damage can overfill you to 118% HP this fight
Healing from damage can overfill you to 130% HP this fight
Healing from damage can overfill you to 145% HP this fight

confluences.name: Deep Fortress
confluences.flavor: The deeper hull and the doubled plate become one thing: a fortress the drowned break themselves on.
confluences.detail: You start every fight with a shield that soaks damage before your HP does. It’s a percentage of your max HP — and since Deep Hull GROWS your max HP as you descend, the shield grows with it.

levels.desc: Start each fight with a shield worth 8% of your max HP
Start each fight with a shield worth 12% of your max HP
Start each fight with a shield worth 16% of your max HP

confluences.name: Cripple
confluences.flavor: Feeble and snared at once. A hull that can neither hit nor run is just target practice.
confluences.detail: With both on-hit hexes running, your hits pile the control on — extra chances to Feeble AND Slow the enemy every shot — and you deal more damage while it flails.

levels.desc: Extra Feeble + Slow on hit; +10% damage
Bigger Feeble + Slow on hit; +16% damage
Heavy Feeble + Slow on hit; +24% damage

confluences.name: Sapping Fire
confluences.flavor: Fire in the timbers and the fight bled out of them. They burn, and they buckle.
confluences.detail: A burning hull is a broken one: your hits carry an extra Feeble, and everything you fire lands harder while the fire eats them.

levels.desc: Extra Feeble on hit; +10% damage
Bigger Feeble on hit; +16% damage
Heavy Feeble on hit; +24% damage

confluences.name: Hobble
confluences.flavor: Snare their rigging, ride their wake. They lumber; you dance.
confluences.detail: A slowed hull can’t keep the pace: your hits Slow harder, and when you take the opening there is a chance to strike twice before they answer.

levels.desc: Extra Slow on hit; opening shot 15% to strike twice
Bigger Slow on hit; opening shot 22% to strike twice
