Heavy Slow on hit; opening shot 30% to strike twice

confluences.name: Coring Shot
confluences.flavor: A cold, hard round that finds the core through any ward and cracks it wide.
confluences.detail: Barriers stop meaning anything: nearly all of your shot skips the shield straight to the hull, and your critical hits land far harder.

levels.desc: Shots ignore 85% of barriers; +18% crit damage
Shots ignore 92% of barriers; +26% crit damage
Shots ignore barriers entirely; +36% crit damage

confluences.name: Clear Skies
confluences.flavor: No fog, no lie, and a target you could hit blindfolded. So you don’t miss.
confluences.detail: Your glass is spotless AND your gold band is huge: nothing clouds your aim, and the perfect-shot window widens so crits come easy.

levels.desc: Immune to aim fog/decoys; gold crit band +16% wider
Immune to aim fog/decoys; gold band +26% wider
Immune to aim fog/decoys; gold band +38% wider

confluences.name: Riposte Wall
confluences.flavor: Turn the blow, and the sea turns it back twice as hard. Nothing that swings at you leaves whole.
confluences.detail: Parry AND thorns, reinforcing each other: you parry more often and reflect harder, and every hit you DO eat is flung back with more spite.

levels.desc: 35% parry / 65% reflect; thrown-back damage +1.6x
45% parry / 80% reflect; thrown-back damage +2.2x
55% parry / 100% reflect; thrown-back damage +3x

confluences.name: Prize Crew
confluences.flavor: What you take, you keep, and what you keep carries over. Their magazine becomes yours.
confluences.detail: A theft engine: you steal enemy cannonballs far more often, and you open every fight already loaded on top of Powder Hoard’s carryover.

levels.desc: +20% steal chance; start each fight +1 loaded
+35% steal chance; start each fight +2 loaded

confluences.name: Deep Terror
confluences.flavor: Frozen solid and seized by the deep. Some hulls never get another turn.
confluences.detail: Total lockdown. The deep needs one hit fewer to drag a hull under, Permafrost’s freezes land on top of it, and you hit harder for the whole fight.

levels.desc: The coils close a hit sooner; +14% damage
A hit sooner again, held 2 turns; +22% damage

confluences.name: Loaded Dice
confluences.flavor: The Don’s luck and a gun that can’t miss the mark. The house always wins now.
confluences.detail: Every fight opens with a STRONGER random blessing, and your guaranteed-crit rhythm speeds up to every other shot.

levels.desc: Stronger fight blessing; every 2nd shot is a guaranteed crit
Even stronger blessing; every 2nd shot crits

confluences.name: Running Broadside
confluences.flavor: Heavy shot and a deep rack. Your gunners learn to loose the big volley on a shorter count.
confluences.detail: Your Volley costs one fewer cannonball — 2 instead of 3 — so you can loose it more often. On top of that, every Volley still hits harder (Grapeshot carries over).

levels.desc: Volley costs 2 charges instead of 3; +10% Volley damage
Volley costs 2; +20% Volley damage
Volley costs 2; +32% Volley damage

confluences.name: Hair Trigger
confluences.flavor: The big gun and a crew that never stops loading. The last word comes a beat sooner.
confluences.detail: Your Mega — the Man-o-War ultimate — costs one fewer cannonball, 3 instead of 4, so it comes online a full charge sooner. It also hits harder still (Man-o-War’s Wrath carries over). Does nothing without a Mega augment.

levels.desc: Mega costs 3 charges instead of 4; +15% Mega damage
Mega costs 3; +26% Mega damage
Mega costs 3; +40% Mega damage

convergences.name: The Reckoning
convergences.flavor: A killer’s eye and a killer’s mark, married. Every clean shot is a verdict.
convergences.detail: Stacks on your two crit synergies: your critical hits deal even more damage, the gold "perfect shot" band widens further, and normal hits gain extra chance to crit. All on top of Coup de Grâce and Bullseye.

levels.desc: +18% crit damage, gold band +12% wider, +10% crit chance
+28% crit damage, gold band +20% wider, +15% crit chance
+40% crit damage, gold band +30% wider, +22% crit chance

convergences.name: Feast of the Deep
convergences.flavor: Every hull you open, the deep drinks — and it has learned to drink faster than you can bleed.
convergences.detail: Builds on your two life-drain synergies: a flat share of ALL the damage you deal comes back as healing, and every shot lands harder. Stacks on top of Reaper’s Tithe and Feeding Frenzy.

levels.desc: Heal 8% of all damage dealt; +10% all damage
Heal 12% of all damage dealt; +16% all damage
Heal 16% of all damage dealt; +24% all damage

convergences.name: Bulwark of the Abyss
convergences.flavor: The deep leans on their guns, not yours. What reaches your hull barely dents it.
convergences.detail: Builds on your two defensive synergies: every hit you take lands for less, and you patch a little hull at the start of every fight. Stacks on top of Pressure Hull and Deep Fortress.

levels.desc: Take -14% damage; heal 5% of max HP each fight start
Take -20% damage; heal 8% of max HP each fight start
Take -28% damage; heal 12% of max HP each fight start

convergences.name: Perfect Storm
convergences.flavor: Never where the shot lands, and every blow that misses is flung back twice as hard.
convergences.detail: Builds on your dodge and retaliation synergies: you slip more shots, and the damage you throw back on a hit climbs higher. Stacks on top of Untouchable and Iron Tempest.

levels.desc: +12% dodge; +15% thrown-back damage
+18% dodge; +25% thrown-back damage
+25% dodge; +40% thrown-back damage

convergences.name: The Vise
convergences.flavor: Feeble, snared, frozen, seized — and then broken. Nothing that meets the vise gets another turn.
convergences.detail: The control capstone: on top of Cripple and Deep Terror, your hits pile on even more Slow, and a locked-down hull simply takes far more damage and crits far more often.

levels.desc: Extra Slow on hit; +18% damage, +14% crit chance
Heavy Slow on hit; +28% damage, +20% crit chance

convergences.name: Executioner's Court
convergences.flavor: Barriers cored, luck loaded, and every clean shot a death sentence read aloud.
convergences.detail: The crit capstone: on top of Coring Shot and Loaded Dice, your critical hits deal even more, land even more often, and the gold band widens further.

levels.desc: +28% crit damage, +16% crit chance, gold band +22% wider
+42% crit damage, +24% crit chance, gold band +34% wider

convergences.name: The Riptide
convergences.flavor: Never where the blow falls, and the sea drags back everything they throw. You are the undertow.
convergences.detail: The evasion capstone: on top of Riposte Wall and Hobble, you slip more shots, take less from the ones that land, and throw more spite back.

levels.desc: +14% dodge, take −12%, +18% thrown-back damage
+20% dodge, take −18%, +28% thrown-back damage
+26% dodge, take −25%, +40% thrown-back damage

convergences.name: The Windfall
convergences.flavor: A full magazine, a clear glass, and a gold band you could not miss if you tried.
convergences.detail: The tempo capstone: on top of Prize Crew and Clear Skies, you open every fight with more shots loaded, and the perfect-shot window widens so crits come easy.

levels.desc: Start each fight +1 loaded; gold band +18% wider, +12% crit chance
Start each fight +2 loaded; gold band +30% wider, +18% crit chance

reprieves.name: Patch the Hull
reprieves.flavor: A frantic hour at the pumps buys back the worst of the damage.

reprieves.name: Beat to Quarters
reprieves.flavor: The bosun pipes all hands. Every gun and trick comes up loaded.

reprieves.name: Load the Guns
reprieves.flavor: You come in at full sail with the gun deck already run out.
reprieves.desc: Open your next fight fully chambered

reprieves.name: Shake the Curse
reprieves.flavor: You throw something dark over the side. The deep takes it back.
reprieves.desc: Shed one of your active curses

davy.3: Down you come. They all come down, in the end.
davy.6: Off the shelf now. The bottom is a long way from caring.
davy.9: Still breathing? The deep is patient. So am I.
davy.13: You stand in my court, captain. None leave it but as crew.
davy.16: Deeper. Yes. Bring me all of it before you sink.
davy.20: No light reaches here. Only me. Only the Locker.
davy.32: Everything that sinks ends up in my silt. You will too.
davy.42: You sail a road paved with things bigger than your ship.
davy.51: Past this line the charts are blank. The chartmakers never came home.
davy.60: Here is where the sea stops asking. Feel the weight, captain.
davy.70: Your pot means nothing to the water. Only to you. That is the joke.
davy.85: The bottom of the world. Even I visit rarely.
davy.100: A hundred fathoms. Sit a while. You have earned the dark.

don.3: You came down to see me. They all do. It never ends well for them.
don.6: The green takes everyone in the end. You just came early.
don.9: Still afloat? The Family respects persistence. Right up until we stop.
don.13: My court now, captain. The kraken keeps the door, and it never opens out.
don.16: Deeper. Good. I like a captain who brings himself to the meeting.
don.20: No sun down here. No law. Just me, and the thing I feed.
don.32: Every debt sinks to the bottom eventually. Yours is past due.
don.42: Feel the coils? That is the house saying hello, captain.
don.51: Past this line the charts all lie. So did everyone who drew them.
don.60: The green closes its fist now. Nothing personal. It never is.
don.70: You counted your pot. The deep counted you. One of you came up short.
don.85: The belly of the world. Even I keep it a short visit.
don.100: A hundred fathoms in my green. Sit. Consider it a standing invitation.

rise.title: Don Finleone Rises
rise.line: So you are the one rattling around my green. Bold, coming down to my table without an invitation. Let me get a look at you.

fall.title: Don Finleone Falls
fall.line: You are better than my Family ever knew, captain. But down here I always come back. Deeper, and hungrier.

rise.title: Don Finleone Rises
rise.line: You put the Don down once. Down here, captain, nobody stays down. And I have a long memory for a face.

fall.title: Don Finleone Falls
fall.line: Twice now. The green has a long memory, and I have a longer one. This is not the last table we sit at.

rise.title: Don Finleone Rises
rise.line: Still coming? The green runs out of patience long before I do. This deep, the water works for the Family.

fall.title: Don Finleone Falls
fall.line: Still standing. Fine. What my guns cannot do, the bottom will. Come down and let it finish you.

rise.title: Don Finleone, The Throne
rise.line: This is the bottom, captain. My table, my terms, my Family all around you. You came all this way to be counted with them. Sit.

fall.title: The Don Is Undone
fall.line: So. The throne is yours to look at. Take your piece of me and get out of my green, while the green still lets you.

terms.name: Smoke and Mirrors
terms.flavor: You will not be shown the shot. Take it anyway.

tiers.desc: Every fight is fought through aim fog
tiers.detail: The Mist Veil hangs over EVERY fight, not just the enemies that bring it. Your aim bar is fogged the whole descent, so the gold band is harder to read and harder to hit. Nothing about the enemy changes, only what you can see of your own shot.

tiers.desc: The fog is heavier, and it never lifts
tiers.detail: As above, but thicker. On a run this long you will be shooting on rhythm and memory rather than sight for most of it.

terms.name: Made Men
terms.flavor: Every one of them is somebody. Go through, or go around.

tiers.desc: Everything you meet arrives behind a barrier
tiers.detail: Every ship down there opens the fight with a shield pool that soaks damage before its hull takes any. You have to break the wall before a single shot counts, which changes what you open with and finally makes Corrode worth carrying.

tiers.desc: The walls are thicker, and they reknit every round
tiers.detail: Bigger barriers, and each one grows a slice of itself back at the top of every round. A slow chip build will never get through one before it is back up, so you need to open it in a single burst.

terms.name: The Long Count
terms.flavor: He has been adding it up since you sat down.

tiers.desc: Enemy ultimates charge faster
tiers.detail: The Don's people load toward their ultimate quicker, so the big authored blow lands sooner and more often. Burning their charges down with a crit strip stops being a luxury.

tiers.desc: They open part-loaded, and it hits harder
tiers.detail: As above, and they start every fight with a cannonball already in the rack, with the ultimate itself landing heavier. The first one can arrive before you have found your rhythm.

terms.name: Bad Blood
terms.flavor: It gets in the water and it stays there.

tiers.desc: Statuses landed on you last twice as long
tiers.detail: Burn, freeze, weaken and everything else the Don's crews put on you runs for double its normal duration. His is the pool that fights with afflictions, so this is the term that makes them bite.

tiers.desc: And nothing you have will wash them off
tiers.detail: As above, and no cleanse works for the whole run. Whatever lands on you stays until it times out on its own, so a Mender stops being an answer to affliction.

terms.name: Every Job
terms.flavor: You do not get to pick which ones you take.

tiers.desc: You cannot turn down a Contract
tiers.detail: Every Contract the Don offers is accepted for you, penalty and all. You are still paid for the ones you finish, but a job you would have walked away from is now yours. The only term on the board that is a wager stacked on a wager.

terms.name: Press-Ganged
terms.flavor: He empties the wrecks and crews them against you.

tiers.desc: Elites are much more common
tiers.detail: Elite ships (the purple ones, tougher and carrying a special affix) show up far more often at every depth.

tiers.desc: Elites are everywhere
tiers.detail: Elite ships appear at roughly double the normal rate, so a stretch of open water without one becomes rare.

terms.name: Marked Hulls
terms.flavor: Every hull he raises comes up already cursed.

tiers.desc: Elites carry TWO affixes, from the very first one
tiers.detail: Normally an elite only starts pairing affixes past depth 30. Now every elite carries two from depth 1, so each one is a combined threat.

tiers.desc: Elites carry two affixes, and some carry three
tiers.detail: Every elite carries two affixes from the start, and roughly one in three carries a third stacked on top.

terms.name: Ironbacked
terms.flavor: Plate over plate, and guns to match.

tiers.desc: Elites are tougher and hit harder
tiers.detail: Elite ships get noticeably more hull and more damage on top of the affix they already carry.

tiers.desc: Elites are far tougher and hit far harder
tiers.detail: Elite ships come with a great deal more hull and damage. An elite becomes a genuine boss-weight fight.

terms.name: Davy's Court
terms.flavor: He does not send more captains. He sends better ones.

tiers.desc: Bosses are tougher and hit harder
tiers.detail: Every boss you meet comes with noticeably more hull and heavier guns. Bosses appear no more often than usual, they are simply worse to meet.

tiers.desc: Bosses are far tougher and hit far harder
tiers.detail: Every boss carries a great deal more hull and lands much heavier blows. A boss becomes the thing most likely to end your run.

terms.name: Crowned
terms.flavor: He sets his own mark on every captain he sends up.

tiers.desc: Every boss carries an elite affix
tiers.detail: Bosses have never carried affixes before. Now every one of them does: a random elite power (Warded, Vampiric, Frenzied, and the rest) stacked on top of everything a boss already is.

tiers.desc: Every boss carries TWO elite affixes
tiers.detail: Every boss comes crowned with two random elite powers at once, merged into a single monstrous captain. Bosses are already the most likely thing to end your run.

terms.name: Nothing but Gold
terms.flavor: A glancing blow is no blow at all. He only counts the clean ones.

tiers.desc: Anything that is not a CRIT deals 25% less damage
tiers.detail: Only critical hits land at full strength. Every ordinary hit and graze is cut by a quarter, so the gold crit band on the aim bar is the whole game. Pure skill: hit it and lose nothing, miss it and bleed damage all run.

tiers.desc: Anything that is not a CRIT deals 50% less damage
tiers.detail: Every hit that is not a critical does HALF damage. If you cannot find the gold band consistently, you will not out-damage anything down there.

terms.name: Skeleton Crew
terms.flavor: Some of them stay at the rail, and some of them do not come back.

tiers.desc: Crew abilities only have a 60% chance to come back after a boss
tiers.detail: Normally beating a boss restores EVERY crew ability. Now each boss kill only has a 60% chance to restore them, so you can be caught with an empty crew for a long stretch.

tiers.desc: Crew abilities only have a 30% chance to come back after a boss
tiers.detail: Beating a boss only has a 30% chance to restore your crew abilities. Expect to fight most of the run with nothing left to call on.

terms.name: Short-Handed
terms.flavor: One berth stays empty. He decides which.

tiers.desc: Sail with one fewer crew for the whole run
tiers.detail: Your last crew slot is left empty for the entire dive. One fewer ability, one fewer set of stats, all the way down.

terms.name: No Communion
terms.flavor: He keeps the powers apart so they never meet.

tiers.desc: Synergies are offered half as often
tiers.detail: When you hold both halves of a synergy, it is offered to you far less often, so a build you commit to may never actually come online.

tiers.desc: Synergies are NEVER offered
tiers.detail: Confluences are switched off completely for this run. You can hold both halves and it will never be offered. Any build that leans on a synergy is dead.

terms.name: Scarce Powder
terms.flavor: Take what you are given. There is no second crate.

tiers.desc: Boon drafts show 2 cards instead of 3
tiers.detail: Every time you are offered a boon you get one fewer option to choose from, so you far more often have to take something that does not fit your build.

tiers.desc: Boon drafts show 2 cards, and come less often
tiers.detail: Boon drafts offer only two cards AND arrive less frequently, so you end the run with a thinner, worse-fitting build.

terms.name: Barren Tides
terms.flavor: The good powder went down with better ships than yours.

tiers.desc: Rare and Legendary boons are much scarcer
tiers.detail: The boon draft skews heavily toward Common cards, so the run-defining Rare and Legendary boons show up far less often.

tiers.desc: Rare and Legendary boons are almost gone
tiers.detail: Nearly everything you are offered is Common. Expect to build a run out of small numbers.

terms.name: Loose Tongue
terms.flavor: He will not stop talking, and every word costs you.

tiers.desc: Curses come more often
tiers.detail: The Locker curses you more frequently than usual. The curses themselves are unchanged, there are simply more of them.

tiers.desc: Curses come more often, and start at their WORST tier
tiers.detail: Curses arrive more frequently AND every one lands at its second, nastier tier straight away instead of building up to it.

terms.name: Deep Draft
terms.flavor: She rides low the whole way down, and she never rides high again.

tiers.desc: Your MAXIMUM hull is cut to 85%
tiers.detail: Your maximum hull is 15% smaller for the entire run. This is not damage you can patch. Every heal, every repair, tops you up to the smaller number.

tiers.desc: Your MAXIMUM hull is cut to 70%
tiers.detail: Your maximum hull is 30% smaller for the entire run. Nothing restores it. You fight the whole descent on a permanently smaller ship.

terms.name: No Mercy
terms.flavor: The anchor does not hold. Not this time.

tiers.desc: Lethal saves do not fire
tiers.detail: Any effect that would normally save you from a killing blow (an Anchor from your equipped items) does nothing. The first blow that would sink you, sinks you. If you carry no Anchor, this costs you nothing.

terms.name: No Quarter
terms.flavor: He offers nothing, and he means it.

tiers.desc: Reprieves never appear
tiers.detail: The relief offers that normally show up between fights (a heal, a curse shed, a second wind) never appear at all.

terms.name: Iron Rations
terms.flavor: Salt beef and bilge water. Nothing down here mends a ship.

tiers.desc: Every heal you get is HALVED
tiers.detail: Everything that would put hull back on your ship gives you half as much: crew heals, repair kits, lifesteal, regeneration, the patch-up between fights, and the reprieves.

tiers.desc: NOTHING heals you. Not one point.
tiers.detail: No healing works at all for the whole run. Crew heals, repair kits, lifesteal, regen, between-fight repairs, reprieves: all of it does nothing. Every point of hull you lose is gone for good.

terms.name: The Full Measure
terms.flavor: He does not take half of anything.

tiers.desc: The Blood Price drops you to 1 hull instead of costing half
tiers.detail: At a Drowned Shrine you can normally bleed HALF your hull onto the stone for an extra boon. Now that offering takes everything: it leaves you on 1 hull. The boon is still yours, if you can survive to use it.

terms.name: No Second Thoughts
terms.flavor: You do not leave his table between hands. You leave when a captain falls.

tiers.desc: You can ONLY cash out after beating a boss
tiers.detail: Normally you may bank your pot at any breather. Now Davy only lets you leave once you have just put a boss down. Frightened halfway between bosses? Too bad. You keep diving, or you sink with the pot.

terms.name: Blind Descent
terms.flavor: Down you go, and you will meet it when you meet it.

tiers.desc: You cannot see what waits below
tiers.detail: The Sounding Line normally shows you what the next fight is (a boss, an elite, or open water) while you decide whether to dive on or cash out. It is gone. Every dive is blind, and so is every decision to keep going.

opposition.label: The Opposition
opposition.blurb: What Davy sends up at you.

gunnery.label: Your Gunnery
gunnery.blurb: What your aim is worth. Shoot well, or do not shoot.

crew.label: Your Crew
crew.blurb: The hands that answer his mechanics.

build.label: Your Fortune
build.blurb: What the descent offers you on the way down.

safety.label: Your Safety Net
safety.blurb: Everything that would have caught you.

opposition.label: The Family
opposition.blurb: Who the Don sits across from you.

gunnery.label: Your Gunnery
gunnery.blurb: What your aim is worth. Shoot well, or do not shoot.

crew.label: Your Crew
crew.blurb: The hands that answer his people.

build.blurb: What the descent offers you on the way down.

safety.blurb: Everything that would have caught you.

upgrades.name: Calm Before
upgrades.description: The Locker's first curse passes you by. You descend uncursed until the second.

upgrades.name: Diving Bell
upgrades.description: Start every Gauntlet run with 15% more max HP.

upgrades.name: Sounding Line
upgrades.description: Before each dive, you can read what waits below: a lone hull, an elite and its trick, or a boss.

upgrades.name: Lucky Locker
upgrades.description: Earn 33% more Fathoms from every dive, win or lose.

upgrades.name: Second Cast
upgrades.description: Once per power draft, throw the offered boons back and draw three fresh ones.

upgrades.name: Salt Ward
upgrades.description: Once per curse the Locker lays on you, throw it back and force a different one. The new curse could be milder, or worse. It's a gamble.

upgrades.name: Iron Hide
upgrades.description: Take 10% less damage from every enemy for the whole Gauntlet run.

upgrades.name: Gunner's Eye
upgrades.description: Deal 10% more damage to every enemy for the whole Gauntlet run.

upgrades.name: Vigor
upgrades.description: Patch up 8% of your max HP each time you sink a ship in the Gauntlet.

upgrades.name: Veteran's Start
upgrades.description: Begin every dive at depth 5: tougher ships, with boons and curses sooner. Pot, chests and Fathoms still count only the ships you sink, so it is no reward shortcut.

upgrades.name: Diviner's Charm
upgrades.description: The deep deals you a better hand. Rare and Legendary boons surface far more often when you draft.

upgrades.name: Salvager's Eye
upgrades.description: Bank 15% more doubloons every time you cash out a Gauntlet run.

upgrades.name: Navigator's Log
upgrades.description: Earn 20% more Nav XP every time you cash out a Gauntlet run.

upgrades.name: Safe Passage
upgrades.description: Your crew never dies on voyages. Sail any route risk-free.

upgrades.name: Extra Cannonball Rack
upgrades.description: Hold 4 cannonballs in raids instead of 3, so one stays loaded right after you fire a volley.

upgrades.name: The Forge
upgrades.description: Unlock the Forge at your ship loadout: fuse a recipe’s component items into one, stacking both effects into a single slot. New recipes are added over time.

upgrades.name: Swift Sails
upgrades.description: Your crew voyages return 30% faster. Less waiting, more sailing.

upgrades.name: Seasoned Timbers
upgrades.description: Your repair kit patches you up 25% more in every raid.

upgrades.name: Tireless Catcher
upgrades.description: Your Auto Catcher reels in rare fish on its own too, not just commons and uncommons.

upgrades.name: Uncursed Descent
upgrades.description: The Locker's first curse passes you by. You descend clean until the second.

upgrades.name: Deep Lungs
upgrades.description: Start every dive with 20% more max HP. A bigger hull for a nastier deep.

upgrades.name: Deep Lungs II
upgrades.description: Deepen your hull: start every dive with 35% more max HP instead.

upgrades.name: Deep Lungs III
upgrades.description: The deepest hull: start every dive with 50% more max HP.

upgrades.name: Ghostlight
upgrades.description: Before each dive, read what waits below: a lone hull, an elite and its trick, or a boss.

upgrades.name: Spoils of the Deep
upgrades.description: Earn 40% more Fathoms from every dive, win or lose. A real early investment that pays for itself over the grind.

upgrades.name: Rechamber
upgrades.description: Once per power draft, throw the offered boons back and draw three fresh ones.

upgrades.name: Rechamber II
upgrades.description: Twice per power draft, throw the offered boons back and draw three fresh ones.

upgrades.name: Break the Hex
upgrades.description: Once per curse the Locker lays on you, throw it back and force a different one. Could be milder, could be worse.

upgrades.name: Break the Hex II
upgrades.description: Twice per curse the Locker lays on you, throw it back and force a different one.

upgrades.name: Blacklist
upgrades.description: Once per dive, banish one offered boon for good. Mark it on any power draft and it never surfaces again for the rest of the run. Cut the dead weight so the good draws come up more often.

upgrades.name: Blacklist II
upgrades.description: Banish up to two boons per dive instead of one. Shape the pool harder toward the build you want.

upgrades.name: Spectral Plate
upgrades.description: Take 12% less damage from every enemy for the whole dive.

upgrades.name: Spectral Plate II
upgrades.description: Thicker plate: take 18% less damage from every enemy for the whole dive.

upgrades.name: Spectral Plate III
upgrades.description: Ghost-forged plate: take 25% less damage from every enemy for the whole dive.

upgrades.name: Ghost Gunners
upgrades.description: Deal 10% more damage to every enemy for the whole dive.

upgrades.name: Ghost Gunners II
upgrades.description: Re-bored guns: deal 16% more damage to every enemy for the whole dive.

upgrades.name: Ghost Gunners III
upgrades.description: The ghost-fleet pattern: deal 22% more damage to every enemy for the whole dive.

upgrades.name: Bloodward
upgrades.description: Patch up 10% of your max HP each time you sink a ship.

upgrades.name: Bloodward II
upgrades.description: Patch up 15% of your max HP each time you sink a ship.

upgrades.name: Bloodward III
upgrades.description: Patch up 22% of your max HP each time you sink a ship.

upgrades.name: Drowned Fortune
upgrades.description: The deep deals you a better hand. Rare and Legendary boons surface far more often.

upgrades.name: Veteran's Start
upgrades.description: Begin every dive at depth 5: tougher ships, boons and curses sooner. Pot, chests and Fathoms still count only the ships you sink.

upgrades.name: Pieces of Eight
upgrades.description: Bank 20% more doubloons every time you cash out a dive.

upgrades.name: Deep Ledger
upgrades.description: Earn 25% more Nav XP every time you cash out a dive.

upgrades.name: Loan Shark
upgrades.description: Sign the Don’s terms: deal 25% MORE damage for the whole dive, but take 18% more from every hit. The debt always comes due. Stacks with your other damage and plate.

upgrades.name: Blood Oath
upgrades.description: Swear in before you dive: start every run already holding one random boon, a favor from the deep to build on from the first fight.

upgrades.name: Consigliere
upgrades.description: The Don whispers in your ear. Synergy offers (confluences and convergences) surface on far more of your power drafts, so you actually build toward them.

upgrades.name: Deep-Sea Plating
upgrades.description: The Don’s shipwrights re-hull you in pressure-forged plate: 10% more ship max HP in EVERY raid and gauntlet dive, forever.

upgrades.name: The Don’s Tribute
upgrades.description: The family looks after its own. Claim 10 Fathoms free from the Locker, once every day. A standing tribute from the deep.

upgrades.name: Kingpin’s Cut
upgrades.description: The Don marks the finest hauls for you: legendary boss-drop items drop twice as often from every raid crate, forever.

upgrades.name: Crimson Tithe
upgrades.description: The Don takes his cut in blood, and hands you a bigger one: earn 15% more Blood Gems from every Hardcore dive you survive.

upgrades.name: Relentless Catcher
upgrades.description: Upgrades your Tireless Catcher: the Auto Catcher now reels in epic fish on its own too, on top of rares. Legendaries and the Ancient Deep still want your hand.

upgrades.name: The Abyssal Forge
upgrades.description: Fuse two forged raid items into one tier-3 Abyssal item, carrying both effect sets in a single mount. The endgame forge.

upgrades.name: The Abyssal Accelerator
upgrades.description: Bolts a transmutation bench onto the Abyssal Forge: charge it with gems, feed it an owned EPIC boss drop, and 24 hours later claim that item’s LEGENDARY chase counterpart. Stop grinding the same fight for the rare roll.

heal.name: Patch Kit
heal.blurb: Ghost-market repairs — mend 35% of your max hull, right here.

cleanse.name: Hex-Breaker
cleanse.blurb: The fence knows a charm-worker. Lift one curse the Locker laid on you.

charges.name: Powder Run
charges.blurb: A crate of shot slid across the counter. Open the next fight with a full rack.

crew.name: Round of Grog
crew.blurb: Rally the deck — every crew ability comes back ready for the next fight.

boon.name: Contraband
boon.blurb: Something fell off a passing hull. An extra power draft, here and now.

fast.name: Fast Work
fast.job: Make it quick, captain. I don't pay for dawdling.
fast.goal: Sink it in 0 turns or fewer.
fast.goalN: Sink it in 9999 turns or fewer.

deadeye.name: Dead-Eye
deadeye.job: Every shot counts down here. Miss the mark once and the deal's off.
deadeye.goal: Land ONLY critical hits — no miss, graze, or plain hit.
deadeye.goalN: Land ONLY critical hits — no miss, graze, or plain hit.

no_crew.name: Tight Quarters
no_crew.job: Handle this one yourself. Leave the crew out of it.
no_crew.goal: Win without firing a single crew ability.
no_crew.goalN: Win without firing a single crew ability.

fire_only.name: Single Shots
fire_only.job: Just the guns. No broadsides, no fireworks.
fire_only.goal: Win using only single fire shots — no volley or Mega.
fire_only.goalN: Win using only single fire shots — no volley or Mega.

volley_only.name: Broadsides Only
volley_only.job: The full broadside, every time. Nothing less.
volley_only.goal: Win using only volleys — no single shot or Mega.
volley_only.goalN: Win using only volleys — no single shot or Mega.

ultimate_only.name: The Big Gun
ultimate_only.job: Show me the big gun, captain. Only the big gun.
ultimate_only.goal: Win using only your Mega — no fire or volley.
ultimate_only.goalN: Win using only your Mega — no fire or volley.

no_dodge.name: Stand Your Ground
no_dodge.job: No weaving. Stand there and take it like it's nothing.
no_dodge.goal: Win without ever taking the Dodge action.
no_dodge.goalN: Win without ever taking the Dodge action.

untouched.name: Not a Scratch
untouched.job: Come back clean. A regular shot lands on you and we're done.
untouched.goal: Take no damage from a normal attack (specials excepted).
untouched.goalN: Take no damage from a normal attack (specials excepted).
